Rogers & Palmer star but Sanchez struggles - Fulham v Chelsea player ratings

It took Joao Pedro just 31 seconds to open the scoring, latching on to a pass from Palmer and lifting his shot over Fulham goalkeeper Bernd Leno for Chelsea 's fastest goal since October 2016.

After King equalised, Rogers marked his debut with a goal before half-time by tapping in from close range.

But it was Palmer - scorer of Chelsea 's third - who stood out most.

He has endured a frustrating 18 months since a niggling groin problem disrupted his sensational start to life at Stamford Bridge, highlighted by the fact he matched last season's Premier League assist tally by setting up Joao Pedro.

His trickery and creativity was on display throughout against Fulham , along with an impressive work-rate. This was more like the Palmer we saw during his first season at Stamford Bridge - and like the one who tore Paris St-Germain apart during last year's Club World Cup final.

"Over the summer I rested, I recharged and, yeah, I'm ready and I'm hungry," Palmer, who is now just two goals away from 50 in the Premier League, told Sky Sports.

During Chelsea 's pre-season tour of Australia, he spoke of having a point to prove and admitted a lengthy summer break felt unusual after featuring in major tournaments in each of the previous three years.

"Cole Palmer was sensational," said former Manchester United defender Gary Neville on Sky Sports. "Him and Morgan Rogers were electric with Joao Pedro - the front three were brilliant.

"That tonight was the old Cole Palmer. It was unbelievable to watch. One of the best things I've seen this weekend."

How two best mates and Joao Pedro linked up

While Palmer and Joao Pedro have generally carried Chelsea 's biggest attacking threat in recent times, they have now been joined by the impressive Rogers.

His arrival reunites him with Palmer, an ex- Manchester City team-mate and someone he described after the win at Craven Cottage as his "best friend in football".

"He had a difficult season with injuries and stuff last year - and you could see it in his eyes in pre-season and training that he's ready this year and ready to prove people wrong," said Rogers when asked about Palmer's display.

"You saw that with that performance. He was the best player on the pitch by a mile and that's what he does. It's good to have him on our side."

Indeed, it was also encouraging how Rogers, whose pre-season was shortened by his involvement in England's run to third place at the World Cup, looked so fit and powerful.

Rogers is the first Chelsea player to score on his Premier League debut since Christopher Nkunku in 2023 - and the first to create five chances in his first league appearance since records began in 2003-04.

This was also the first time Chelsea supporters sang the new Rogers chant in the away end.

Like Palmer, Joao Pedro missed out on the World Cup - as a high-profile omission from Brazil's squad - but returned in pre-season with eight goals in seven games.

It was no surprise to see him on the scoresheet so early in the Premier League campaign, having inherited the number nine shirt from Liam Delap, who was left out of the squad on Monday, and following the contract extension the Brazilian signed at the weekend.

"Great combination, great quality," Alonso told BBC Match of the Day when asked about his front three.

"We know if we reach them [Joao Pedro, Morgan Rogers and Cole Palmer] in good positions, they have this talent to create special things and I am very happy the three forwards have scored.

"We need to put them in the best situations. I am happy for the three of them. They played for the team."

'Sanchez will undermine everything they do'

Yet questions remain over Sanchez, who allowed King's low strike to go straight through him for Fulham 's equaliser and then tamely parried Timothy Castagne's shot into a dangerous area for Garcia to head in from close range to set up a nervy finish.

"They have strengthened in every position of the pitch but you cannot take a chance on goalkeepers," said Neville.

"I've said before it's the most difficult position on the pitch, it's the one that carries the most scrutiny and if you have got a goalkeeper who's making mistakes and is anxious, it will undermine everything you're trying to do.

"It's a problem. You've got to say it's a problem."

King's equaliser in the 23rd minute had an expected goals on target (xGoT) value of just 0.05, making it the lowest-rated shot to result in a goal during the opening weekend of the Premier League season.

In other words, Sanchez really should have saved it.

He did make a number of other saves, but he also conceded a corner after failing to clear the ball before it ran out of play and was later unconvincing when coming off his line to deal with a long ball, with Antonee Robinson missing the target to let him off the hook.

While Alonso defended his goalkeeper after the game, in his pre-match news conference on Thursday he had said: "The pitch is the boss of everything. I don't decide. The players need to show me."

That message applied to his goalkeepers - Sanchez and number two Mike Penders, 21, who is waiting to make his debut after returning from a successful loan spell at Strasbourg.

With the transfer window still open, many Chelsea fans will be asking whether the club need a new first-choice goalkeeper.

As Carragher said: "They have to sort the goalkeeping issue out because it's going to come back and haunt them again this season as it did tonight."

articles.title: Del Mou más entrañable, al más punzante
articles.summary: Me gusta mucho muchísimo el José Mourinho de esta segunda etapa. Consciente que viene a un Real Madrid que ha cambiado muchísimo y donde el entrenador no es más importante que los jugadores. Muy bien por parte del entrenador portugués por informarse y tomar conciencia de dónde venía.
articles.body: Me gusta mucho muchísimo el José Mourinho de esta segunda etapa. Consciente que viene a un Real Madrid que ha cambiado muchísimo y donde el entrenador no es más importante que los jugadores. Muy bien por parte del entrenador portugués por informarse y tomar conciencia de dónde venía. Desde que llegó a Valdebebas le hemos visto próximo, cercano y cariñoso como nunca con abrazo casi paternal con Florentino Pérez, comentando que en las Champions ganadas por Zidane y Ancelotti el presidente le llamaba para decirle que parte de esos triunfos eran suyos. Una circunstancia que le ruborizaba reconociendo sinceramente que quienes habían ganado eran los jugadores con Carlo y Zidane. Me ha gustado y mucho que haya hablado con los fichajes y no fichajes para explicarles lo que quería de ellos y, lo más importante, si querían estar en el club blanco. Además de convencer a Cucurella o Bernardo para que ficharan, se dio cuenta enseguida en dos conversaciones que Rodri se marchaba al Barça. Y, por supuesto, informarse de primera mano que Vinicius quería seguir en el club blanco. Se abrazó con Espí en el campo del Espanyol como un padre con un hijo el día de su boda. Está tranquilo y relajado en las ruedas de prensa. Se le ve feliz y lo que es consciente que será un año duro difícil pero que algún título volverá seguro a llevar a las vitrinas de Chamartín. Algo menos me gusta que haya hablado del caso y de situación procesal del caso Negreira recordando que en su último año en el club alguien ya le dejó caer la trama del Barça con Negreira. Desde luego, sabe que eso no toca ahora pero la deja caer a los árbitros para presionarles. Pero no contento habla de bullying a Vinicius en Barcelona. Aunque a Vini se le hostiga, utilizar esa palaba es grave para esis niños y niñas que sufren este tipo de acoso tan brutal y dañino. Mourinho ya comienza a presionar árbitros y a focalizar en ellos los problemas dentro y fuera de los terrenos de juego. Vinicius no necesita ese apoyo de su entrenador, necesita cariño, ánimos de la afición que no hace mucho tiempo no paraba de pitarle en el Bernabéu. Bienvenido Mou, pero nos gusta más el Mou entrañable que el avinagrado y punzante de antaño. Veremos hasta cuando le dura.  A Luis de la Fuente no le importaría, es más le gustaría, llevar la Copa del Mundo con su presidente Louzán a Ceuta para dar ánimos a los ceutíes que lo están pasando muy mal. El seleccionador que ya estuvo con algunos damnificados por los incendios, cree que la Copa es un motivo de ánimo para aficionados que lo están pasando tan mal. El 23 de septiembre José Ramón de la Morena en Brunete presentará una nueva edición de la Gala del Altruismo en la que serán premiados Dani Martín, Sergio Canales y Gonzalo Sánchez, voluntario en Adamuz y Ceuta. Además estarán José Mercé, Café Quijano y Chaito & PaloSanto. De la Morena homenajea a los más solidarios.

Desde que llegó a Valdebebas le hemos visto próximo, cercano y cariñoso como nunca con abrazo casi paternal con Florentino Pérez, comentando que en las Champions ganadas por Zidane y Ancelotti el presidente le llamaba para decirle que parte de esos triunfos eran suyos. Una circunstancia que le ruborizaba reconociendo sinceramente que quienes habían ganado eran los jugadores con Carlo y Zidane. Me ha gustado y mucho que haya hablado con los fichajes y no fichajes para explicarles lo que quería de ellos y, lo más importante, si querían estar en el club blanco. Además de convencer a Cucurella o Bernardo para que ficharan, se dio cuenta enseguida en dos conversaciones que Rodri se marchaba al Barça. Y, por supuesto, informarse de primera mano que Vinicius quería seguir en el club blanco. Se abrazó con Espí en el campo del Espanyol como un padre con un hijo el día de su boda. Está tranquilo y relajado en las ruedas de prensa. Se le ve feliz y lo que es consciente que será un año duro difícil pero que algún título volverá seguro a llevar a las vitrinas de Chamartín. Algo menos me gusta que haya hablado del caso y de situación procesal del caso Negreira recordando que en su último año en el club alguien ya le dejó caer la trama del Barça con Negreira. Desde luego, sabe que eso no toca ahora pero la deja caer a los árbitros para presionarles. Pero no contento habla de bullying a Vinicius en Barcelona. Aunque a Vini se le hostiga, utilizar esa palaba es grave para esis niños y niñas que sufren este tipo de acoso tan brutal y dañino. Mourinho ya comienza a presionar árbitros y a focalizar en ellos los problemas dentro y fuera de los terrenos de juego. Vinicius no necesita ese apoyo de su entrenador, necesita cariño, ánimos de la afición que no hace mucho tiempo no paraba de pitarle en el Bernabéu. Bienvenido Mou, pero nos gusta más el Mou entrañable que el avinagrado y punzante de antaño. Veremos hasta cuando le dura.  A Luis de la Fuente no le importaría, es más le gustaría, llevar la Copa del Mundo con su presidente Louzán a Ceuta para dar ánimos a los ceutíes que lo están pasando muy mal. El seleccionador que ya estuvo con algunos damnificados por los incendios, cree que la Copa es un motivo de ánimo para aficionados que lo están pasando tan mal. El 23 de septiembre José Ramón de la Morena en Brunete presentará una nueva edición de la Gala del Altruismo en la que serán premiados Dani Martín, Sergio Canales y Gonzalo Sánchez, voluntario en Adamuz y Ceuta. Además estarán José Mercé, Café Quijano y Chaito & PaloSanto. De la Morena homenajea a los más solidarios.

articles.title: Mourinho señala al banquillo
articles.standfirst: El entrenador del Madrid valora la aportación de los suplentes como un factor decisivo, algo que la temporada pasada no existió
articles.summary: El entrenador del Madrid valora la aportación de los suplentes como un factor decisivo, algo que la temporada pasada no existió
articles.body: El Real Madrid ganó su primer partido de Liga con un gol de un suplente. El tanto de Carlos Espí con el reloj ya en el minuto 90 dio a los blancos los tres primeros puntos. La figura de Joselu apareció en la mente de los madridistas. Porque desde su marcha en el verano de 2024, el Madrid se había quedado huérfano de jugadores que entraran para cambiar la suerte de los partidos. La temporada pasada, el Madrid fue de los equipo del campeonato liguero que menos rendimiento sacó a su banquillo. Seis goles llegaron a través de jugadores que empezaron el partido en el banquillo: Vincius (en Oviedo), Bellingham (ante el mismo rival, pero en Chamartín), Güler (contra el Elche) y Fran García (al Betis), Militao (Mallorca) y Brahim (Athletic). Todos ellos llegaron en cuando el marcador ya estaba de cara para el equipo blanco. Sólo el del central brasileño tuvo valor real, porque era el 2-0 y luego Muriqi, al borde del final, apretó el marcador. Tanto en la rueda de prensa previa al partido con el Espanyol como en la posterior, Mourinho lanzó mensajes de la importancia que tiene en su plan que la plantilla esté conectada. "Tienen que ser conscientes de que no puedo poner a 14 de inicio", explicó antes del choque. Un mensaje-aviso en el que profundizó después de la victoria lograda con el gol de un suplente, Carlos Espí. "Valoro mucho esta victoria, porque ha sido una victoria con alma y también de banquillo. Yo digo siempre: un banquillo frustrado no ayuda nada. Un banquillo con sentimiento de equipo, cuando tienes la calidad que nosotros tenemos, te puede ayudar a ganar", explicaba el entrenador portugués.  Un mensaje en el que después ahondó: "Lo difícil es que tú inicies el partido con once y tengas doce en el banquillo. Tenemos algún lesionado, porque si no tenemos lesionados tendremos que dejar a alguno en casa. Esta es una cosa que he dicho a los jugadores que no puedo solucionar. No puedo hacer el milagro de empezar un partido con 14 o 15 jugadores. Son ellos los que tienen que luchar contra la frustración de no iniciar un partido o de no jugar. Son ellos los que tienen que entender que yo tengo el corazón partido por dejar gente fuera. Y si ellos no trabajan o pierden motivación, es muy fácil para mí dejar gente fuera. Los cinco jugadores que han entrado hoy he sentido que han entrado para ayudar, con un buen feeling. Y tiene que ser así. He dicho desde el primer día que ni en amistosos el Madrid se puede dar el lujo de no luchar para ganar. Vamos a perder partidos, espero que no muchos, pero el Madrid tiene que jugar cuatro competiciones en serio y no podemos hacerlo con diez, con once, con doce o con quince. Necesitamos a esta plantilla. Esto es lo que me espero de ellos: profesionalidad y voluntad de trabajar para el equipo. Tienen que ser ellos”. Un mensaje diáfano al corazón del vestuario. Mourinho no quiere que un equipo en el que el rol de titular minimice al resto. Habrá jugadores con muchos galones, pero quiere al resto con las orejas tiesas, algo que en las dos últimas temporadas se ha echado de menos en la Casa Blanca. La Unidad B, que tantas cosas le dio a Carlo Ancelotti en la temporada 2023-24, la de las graves lesiones de Courtois, Militao y Alaba, redujo de manera notable su aportación. Hasta el punto de ser casi inapreciable su rendimiento. "Los periodistas dais mucha importancia al once inicial. Creo que importa más el que acaba los partidos", explicaba Ancelotti sobre este fútbol con cinco cambios y en el que el impacto de las plantillas se ha multiplicado. Otro ejemplo está en la España campeona del mundo y el valor de jugadores como Mikel Merino, Ferran o Nico Williams. El fútbol de once jugadores fijos es historia. El valor del banquillo es crucial. Ese vacío del banquillo de la temporada pasada es un aspecto que Mourinho se marcó como punto a mejorar. De momento, el primer partido de Liga lo ha ganado a través de esa vía. La temporada pasada, el Barcelona encontró victorias y soluciones múltiples desde sus reservas. Lewandowski, Raphinha o Rashford entraron para cambiar y ganar partidos. En este Madrid de Mou, los jugadores ya saben que no va a ser cosa sólo de los etiquetados como titulares.

articles.title: Gianni Infantino: 'Change is necessary' - players unite against Fifa president
articles.summary: A number of current and former footballers unite against Fifa president Gianni Infantino, stating that "change is necessary" at the global governing body.
articles.body:
A number of current and former footballers have united against under-pressure Fifa president Gianni Infantino, stating "change is necessary" at the head of the global governing body.

Former Manchester United and France defender Mikael Silvestre, who sits on Fifa's Players' Voice Panel, issued a statement on X , external on Monday in a post he titled "Enough is Enough!".

The statement has been shared on social media by the likes of England defender Lucy Bronze, France's 1998 World Cup winner Emmanuel Petit, and former England goalkeeper David James.

It follows Infantino's controversial plan to sell stakes in competitions, including the World Cup, to private investors, with the statement saying players "share the exact same concerns as the millions of fans around the world".

Criticising how the governing body operates, it added: "We have watched the game we love drift away from its core values under Fifa's current leadership.

"For too long we've seen major decisions taken without players being consulted or considered, and without any regard for the fans who sustain the sport."

Uefa chief Ceferin rules out Fifa presidency bid Published 1 day ago

Uefa chief Ceferin rules out Fifa presidency bid

Infantino asked to stay away from youth tournament Published 3 days ago

Infantino asked to stay away from youth tournament

The statement continued: "Change is necessary. Power has blurred the current leadership's ability to distinguish between its own interests and what is best for football.

"Recent events have made silence impossible."

It also called for unity from "grassroots to the top of the game" in support of "structural change" at Fifa, with players and fans getting a "real, direct say" in how the sport is run.

Infantino has faced sustained pressure to his leadership in recent weeks, with backlash from several confederations in response to the Fifa Forward Enterprise (FFE) controversy.

Uefa has threatened to boycott all Fifa competitions, with the European confederation's president Aleksander Ceferin saying he expects Infantino to resign or face a challenge in an election next March. Numerous national governing bodies, including the football associations of England, Wales and Scotland, have withdrawn support.

Silvestre's involvement represents a challenge from within Fifa itself, with the 16-strong Players' Voice Panel having been formed by the governing body to monitor and advise on tackling racism in football.

Infantino has, however, found support from former Barcelona striker Samuel Eto'o, president of the Cameroonian Football Association, who doesn't believe the Fifa leader has "done anything wrong".

"I remain convinced that for us as Africans, this project was something that could have been incredible," Eto'o told CNN , external on Monday.

"It would have reset the balance of power in football to ensure that our talent doesn't disappear and end up playing for other nations.

"Infantino has changed football. He's given opportunities to nations that didn't have those opportunities to take part in the most beautiful tournament, the World Cup He enabled smaller nations to get seats at these competitions. He has helped our continent. He's helped our federations to develop much more quickly, and we need to acknowledge that."

articles.title: El Villarreal llega a un acuerdo por Saliba
articles.standfirst: Los amarillos pagarán 15 millones al Anderlecht por el traspaso del centrocampista
articles.summary: Los amarillos pagarán 15 millones al Anderlecht por el traspaso del centrocampista
articles.body: El Villarreal ha decidido finalmente no apurar hasta última hora del mercado y acometer el fichaje del centrocampista que cierre definitivamente su plantilla. Y este será Nathan Saliba, canadiense de 22 años que llega procedente del Anderlecht y por el que la entidad castellonense abonará 15 millones de euros. El futbolista llegará en las próximas horas a España para completar los trámites y firmar por el conjunto azulejero. Internacional con su país y mundialista este pasado verano, en el “submarino” volverá a verse las caras con dos compatriotas como son Tajon Buchanan y Tani Oluwaseyi. De esta forma completará un centro del campo en el que Iñigo Pérez ya tiene a su disposición a Pape Gueye, Comesaña y los canteranos Diatta y Carlos Macià. Nathan-Dylan Saliba recaló el pasado verano en el Anderlecht en una transferencia tasada en 2 millones de euros. Nombrado 'Jugador Joven del Año' en Canadá en 2024, cuenta con ascendencia haitiana y libanesa. Precisamente el pasaporte haitiano le permite jugar como comunitario gracias al artículo 64 del Acuerdo de Samoa, sucesor del tratado de Cotonú. Saliba es un mediocentro que destaca por su dinamismo y despliegue en el centro del campo y su gran capacidad para robar balones . No es un jugador alto (1.73) pero su agresividad defensiva le convierten en un jugador perfecto para la presión alta que propugna Iñigo Pérez y que permite robar en campo rival. Durante este periodo ha destacado también por su capacidad ofensiva y buen golpeo de balón.

articles.title: La inesperada alternativa a Julián: “Tiene mucho talento y al Barcelona le podría venir bien”
articles.standfirst: Jorge Segura señala a Mikautadze como una opción más económica a Julián Álvarez para reforzar la delantera azulgrana.
articles.summary: Jorge Segura señala a Mikautadze como una opción más económica a Julián Álvarez para reforzar la delantera azulgrana.
articles.body: El futuro de la delantera del Barcelona sigue generando debate ante la posibilidad de buscar un nuevo '9'. Jorge Segura analizó en La Tribu de Radio MARCA las alternativas que podría manejar el conjunto azulgrana y defendió que existen opciones mucho más económicas que Julián Álvarez. Segura utilizó el caso de Aubameyang para explicar la importancia de contar con un delantero con facilidad para marcar. "Es de esos jugadores que, como se suele utilizar la expresión, se le caen los goles. Es la realidad" aseguró. Para el periodista, hay cualidades que van mucho más allá del físico o la técnica: "Hay jugadores que tienen ese talento y que por tiempo que lleven o por años que tengan siguen haciendo goles porque eso se tiene o no se tiene". A la hora de hablar del Barça, Jorge Segura considera que el club no tendría necesariamente que realizar una inversión del calibre de la que exigiría una operación por Julián Álvarez. "Yo creo que el Barça podría encontrar perfectamente un delantero centro, no digo Aubameyang, evidentemente, pero podría encontrar un delantero centro por mucho menos dinero de lo que vale Julián Álvarez", explicó. Eso sí, Segura también dejó claro que una alternativa más económica tendría sus riesgos: "Seguramente un delantero de menos talento de lo que vale Julián Álvarez. ¿Que habría que pagarlo? Sí. ¿Que podría suponer un riesgo? También". En ese escenario puso sobre la mesa el nombre de Mikautadze, delantero del Villarreal, después de las sensaciones que le está dejando en este inicio de temporada. "Mikautadze, por el precio que piden, me parece que es un jugador que tiene mucho talento y que además en el sistema de juego Barça le podría venir bien", afirmó Segura. Segura también valoró lo que podría significar Aubameyang para un Deportivo que afrontaría la temporada con el objetivo de mantenerse en Primera."Cuando un equipo que pelea por la permanencia tiene un delantero como Aubameyang, lo tiene más fácil", señaló. Como ejemplo recordó lo sucedido la pasada temporada con el Levante y Carlos Espí: "El mejor ejemplo que puedo poner fue la temporada pasada en Levante, que acaba salvándose porque tiene un Carlos Espí en el segundo tramo de la temporada espectacular".

Segura también valoró lo que podría significar Aubameyang para un Deportivo que afrontaría la temporada con el objetivo de mantenerse en Primera."Cuando un equipo que pelea por la permanencia tiene un delantero como Aubameyang, lo tiene más fácil", señaló. Como ejemplo recordó lo sucedido la pasada temporada con el Levante y Carlos Espí: "El mejor ejemplo que puedo poner fue la temporada pasada en Levante, que acaba salvándose porque tiene un Carlos Espí en el segundo tramo de la temporada espectacular".

articles.title: Balde ya ha decidido: quiere dejar el Barcelona
articles.standfirst: Mendes y Deco buscan un destino; el United ahora sólo quiere una cesión
articles.summary: Mendes y Deco buscan un destino; el United ahora sólo quiere una cesión
articles.body: El futuro de Alejandro Balde ha dado un vuelco en los últimos diez días. Hasta ese momento, aunque había muchos rumores desde hacía tiempo sobre su salida, todo parecía indicar que se quedaría en el Barcelona. De hecho, ese fue siempre el deseo del jugador, obviando todo tipo de rumores y ofertas procedentes de diversos clubes europeos. Y así lo reflejó en algunas declaraciones. Todo ha cambiado desde que el club ha fichado oficialmente a Joao Cancelo. Aunque se sabía que esa era la intención de la Dirección Deportiva, su llegada no se concretó hasta hace unos días. Y, a partir de ahí, todo cambió para Balde. Es cierto que el jugador sabía que su rol esta temporada iba a ser diferente porque no partía como titular fijo, pero estaba dispuesto a luchar por un puesto. La decisión de Flick de dejarle fuera de la convocatoria para el partido frente al Elche ha sido el detonante. Porque, además, ahí vio que Xavi Espart, titular en el Martínez Valero, podía estar por delante de él. Después de las distintas conversaciones que se han producido en las últimas horas, el jugador ha tomado la decisión de dejar el Barcelona en este mercado estival. Tanto Jorge Mendes, representante del jugador, como el Barcelona se han puesto manos a la obra para buscarle un destino. Balde tiene cartel, pero nos encontramos a una semana del cierre del mercado y la gran mayoría de los clubes han hecho los deberes y tienen prácticamente confeccionadas sus plantillas. Eso quiere decir que algunas puertas se han cerrado. El Manchester United sigue siendo el mejor colocado. Sin embargo, ha cambiado un detalle. Después de los fichajes que ha realizado en los últimos días, el club inglés ha descartado un traspaso. Ahora quiere una cesión. Aunque el Barcelona pretende una venta, dada la premura de tiempo podría aceptar la fórmula del préstamo. Hay más ofertas sobre la mesa, aunque no tan tentadoras. No se prevé un desenlace inminente para esta situación, que ha explotado en los últimos días. Mendes y Deco siguen buscando soluciones para Balde y la solución podría demorarse hasta los últimos días de mercado.

articles.title: Roberto Gómez: "La situación de Vinicius es preocupante"
articles.standfirst: El periodista analiza en La Tribu la postura de Mourinho con el brasileño, al que considera que hay que proteger del acoso, y también reclama que la Copa del Mundo visite Ceuta
articles.summary: El periodista analiza en La Tribu la postura de Mourinho con el brasileño, al que considera que hay que proteger del acoso, y también reclama que la Copa del Mundo visite Ceuta
articles.body: Roberto Gómez puso el foco en Vinicius y José Mourinho durante su intervención en La Tribu con Javi Amaro. El periodista mostró su preocupación por todo lo que rodea al futbolista brasileño y defendió que debe ser protegido ante determinadas situaciones: "A Vinicius hay que protegerle de todo tipo de acoso". El colaborador de Radio MARCA puso como ejemplo una acción del último encuentro ante el Espanyol para explicar su postura. "No vale eso de que provoca. El otro día le da una patada Cala, que es de expulsión", aseguró. Una jugada sobre la que fue todavía más contundente: "Es una expulsión y no pasa absolutamente nada. La gente se queda con el piscinazo". Precisamente ahí apareció Mourinho en el análisis de Roberto Gómez. El periodista reconoció que le sorprendió la postura adoptada por el técnico respecto al brasileño: "Me sorprendió un poquito el tema de Mourinho respecto a la situación del jugador". Gómez volvió a remarcar la necesidad de proteger a Vinicius: "Indudablemente lo que no puede ser es el acoso al que se le somete en muchas ocasiones". Para el periodista, todo lo que rodea al brasileño merece atención: "El tema de Vinicius es muy preocupante. Se quiere quedara aquí. Es buenísimo". Al margen de esta cuestión, Gómez sí se mostró satisfecho con la versión de Mourinho que ha encontrado desde su llegada al Real Madrid. "La llegada ha sido muy tranquila. No sé si es producto de los años. A mí me han gustado muchísimas cosas", señaló. Y añadió: "Me gusta este Mourinho, como muy cercano, como muy próximo. Yo diría que hasta casi tierno". Durante su intervención, Roberto Gómez también reclamó una mayor implicación del fútbol español con Ceuta y pidió que la Copa del Mundo recorra diferentes puntos del país. "Yo creo que sería una inyección de moral para nuestros compatriotas, para los Ceuta", explicó. El periodista fue especialmente crítico con la posibilidad de que el trofeo permanezca en la Federación: "¿Qué pinta la Copa en la Federación Española? Tiene que estar rodando por España. Que es un signo de orgullo". Además, extendió su petición a las zonas afectadas por los incendios: "La Copa tiene que estar con la gente de los incendios. La moral que les daría a la gente de Niebla. A la gente de Pinofranqueado. De la Sierra de Madrid". Para Gómez, "la Copa es una cosa que nos une absolutamente a todos".

articles.title: Transfer window 2026: What does your Premier League club need with a week to go?
articles.summary: BBC Sport takes a look at what each of the Premier League clubs still need before the summer transfer window shuts in seven days.
articles.body:
The first weekend of the Premier League season is complete but clubs still have one week of the transfer window remaining to secure last-minute squad additions.

Results are one thing but for many managers and sporting directors their opening match was an eye-opener in what positions need to be strengthened, who is no longer needed and what gaps still need to be plugged.

With the transfer window closing on Tuesday, 1 September at 23:00 BST, BBC Sport takes a look at what each top-flight club still needs and fans also have their say.

The Premier League champions have already strengthened the middle of the pitch with Bruno Guimaraes, the wing with Christos Tzolis and their defence with Ezri Konsa.

But Arsenal are still in the market for a forward and have a long-standing interest in Julian Alvarez.

Although it appears to be a difficult deal due to many factors, the Gunners will be ready to act if there is a chance to get it done.

If you want someone who is Premier League proven, who has won it all from the World Cup to the Champions League, Julian Alvarez looks like the guy that can take Arsenal to the promised land of finally getting over the line in Europe. Especially when there aren't that many elite forwards in the world.

Alvarez's Arsenal dilemma amid summer's most bitter transfer tussle Published 1 day ago

Alvarez's Arsenal dilemma amid summer's most bitter transfer tussle

Al-Hilal open talks to sign Arsenal winger Martinelli Published 1 day ago

Al-Hilal open talks to sign Arsenal winger Martinelli

What don't Aston Villa need after a raft of star departures this summer?

Ollie Watkins' transfer saga, with Saudi Pro League side Al-Hilal trying to sign the striker, leaves Villa looking for a likely replacement with Nicolas Jackson a target.

A winger is also on the agenda while they need a defender after Ezri Konsa's move to Arsenal , and have opened talks for Club Brugge central defender Joel Ordonez after bids for Southampton centre-back Taylor Harwood-Bellis were rejected.

It is clear Aston Villa desperately require a striker more than anything right now.

Although I massively rate Victor Lindelof and Pau Torres, the display against Brighton has worried me slightly.

Therefore, I would welcome another centre-back as well.

It looks like we will be OK in midfield once Johan Manzambi is fit and with the addition of Leon Goretzka.

Watkins' departure would cut deepest - and Villa did not see it coming Published 1 day ago

Watkins' departure would cut deepest - and Villa did not see it coming

Villa in talks with Club Brugge for defender Ordonez Published 1 day ago

Villa in talks with Club Brugge for defender Ordonez

Bournemouth are used to being picked off and will simply be hoping to come through the final eight days of the transfer window unscathed.

It is clear that big clubs are circling for forward Eli Junior Kroupi and midfielder Alex Scott, who the Cherries insist are not for sale.

In terms of incomings, Bournemouth are largely done as they close in on a move for Juventus goalkeeper Michele Di Gregorio.

Brentford are in the fortunate position of being able to choose their deals carefully after some excellent squad strengthening.

The Bees have been looking at left-back, with West Ham's El Hadji Malick Diouf strongly linked, but it hardly seems a matter of urgency with Keane Lewis-Potter able to play as a wing-back with Rico Henry and Aaron Hickey also in the mix.

There is experienced striking cover in the shape of former England international Callum Wilson and an all-round depth to Keith Andrews' squad that was missing last season.

Do not expect it to be a hectic closing few days in the transfer window.

Another forward option - particularly down the left - would take this window for Brentford from a nine to a 10 out of 10.

Mykhailo Mudryk's name has been doing the rounds in recent weeks and Brentford have history there, having chased him prior to his move to Chelsea .

Get someone like Mudryk in, and I don't think the transfer window could've gone much better for Andrews.

It is anticipated Yankuba Minteh will leave for Liverpool , which might create space at Brighton for another forward and Carlos Baleba's exit for Manchester United may see the club make a move for midfield reinforcements.

It is possible there may be other exits but, as usual, Brighton will stick to their data driven recruitment plan.

"We must continue to evolve, invest and innovate while remaining true to the principles that have brought us this far," was chairman Tony Bloom's message to fans before the 4-0 win against Aston Villa .

With Baleba's anticipated departure and Minteh looking likely that he might leave as well, we need to bring a defensive midfielder who can bring a physical presence to our midfield and a winger who is proven at the top level.

We have a lot of games this season with European football, so we need to have the squad depth to compete on all fronts if we want to secure a top-10 finish again.

Chelsea supporters may want another star forward or a new goalkeeper to replace the unconvincing Robert Sanchez, but Xabi Alonso feels his squad is largely complete for this summer.

However, there is a huge amount of work to do to reduce the squad from 39 players to around 25 within the next eight days. That is the priority, as the Blues will not want frustrated players in their squad this season.

Chelsea need to focus more on the outgoings than incoming players.

With no Europe it's important we do not carry a squad that's too heavy, as we won't have too much room for rotation.

If we were to bring anybody in, I think the priority is a top-drawer goalkeeper.

Coventry are in the hunt for Mykhailo Mudryk as the Chelsea winger looks to get his career back on track after serving a 20 month suspension for testing positive for banned substance meldonium.

Defensive cover is also likely to be needed by Frank Lampard while players like Luke Woolfenden could leave on loan.

Honestly, I think we have done enough in the transfer window to build a team that can stay up in this league.

There has been a lot of change at Palace with the loss of Maxence Lacroix and a new manager starting the season in Pierre Sage.

The Eagles have been building depth for their Europa League campaign but still need a few bodies in the building.

Sage has made clear he wants a senior centre-back and Palace could be pushed to sign another defender too after the injury to Chadi Riad in the first game of the Premier League season against Everton .

Riad's injury has amplified the need for another centre-back who is first-team ready.

Axel Disasi is a good start, but a bigger, permanent move would be great. That, plus a central midfielder, and we are set.

Mateta's contract claim leaves Palace with transfer decision Published 1 day ago

Mateta's contract claim leaves Palace with transfer decision

Everton simply must sign a recognised right-back before the window shuts. It has been a glaring problem for more than a year.

It is a weakness recognised by everyone at the club but either a prime target cannot be agreed upon or is out of reach.

Talented midfielder Merlin Rohl took on the job for the opening game against Crystal Palace, while Jake O'Brien and James Garner have also been pressed into service.

Time to finally make a decision and get one in. Maybe David Moyes will also look at adding another striker with questions still hanging over Beto and Thierno Barry.

Chelsea outcast Liam Delap is one name regularly linked with Everton .

Fulham manager Alvaro Arbeloa has been clear that he is happy with the club's business so far, but more could be done to make his squad more balanced.

There have been attempts to sign an additional central defender, with a move for Rennes' Abdelhamid Ait Boudlal explored two weeks ago, and that could be a key area the Cottagers look to strengthen.

This is a club that does not operate at the very top end of the transfer market and one that enjoys a deadline-day deal.

It still feels like Fulham need a right winger - whether that is sticking with Oscar Bobb or providing serious competition for him - I think we need to cover for the loss of Harry Wilson's goals.

We also need a right-sided centre-back as there are serious concerns over how Joachim Anderson will fit Arbeloa's new system.

It has already been a busy summer for Hull City 's recruitment team but the ambitious Tigers are still working on adding two new forwards in Mohamed Ali-Cho and Ilyas Ansah.

There has also been interest from the club in Real Betis winger Pablo Garcia, although that deal has taken longer than hoped after the La Liga side raised their valuation of the 20-year-old. Stoke City's Sorba Thomas is also a player of interest.

A goalkeeper, midfielder and right-back also could be on the agenda for Sergej Jakirovic's side in the final week of the window.

Over the next week, if we bring in a left winger, one more striker - assuming the Ali-Cho deal also gets completed - a central midfielder, an attacking midfielder and a right-back to add depth and challenge Lewie Coyle for the starting spot, we will be in a strong position to compete.

Ipswich have spent over Â£150m on 12 new signings since returning to the Premier League.

Boss Gary O'Neil expects more, though, and a striker and a midfielder could arrive at Portman Road.

Fringe players like Anis Memeti could leave as O'Neil shapes his squad.

Having pushed the boat out to sign James Trafford from Manchester City , big money signings are probably off the agenda for Leeds in the last week of the window.

They are interested in taking Mykhailo Mudryk on loan but have not been able to strike a deal with the London club as yet as they are looking at other left wingers.

Leeds are also considering back-up options for forwards Dominic Calvert-Lewin and Lukas Nmecha and have also been linked with Frankfurt goalkeeper Michael Zetterer, if Lucas Perri joins Torino on loan as expected.

Leeds have had a great transfer window but they badly need another left-footed left-back as cover for Gabriel Gudmundsson.

Beyond that, perhaps another forward or creative midfielder to contend with Harry Wilson, Brenden Aaronson and Noah Okafor.

As has been the case for most of the summer, Liverpool 's priority remains the wide attacking areas and the expectation is that at least one and maybe two wingers will come in over the coming week.

Andoni Iraola said that personnel was not the issue when it came to defensive midfielders, the manner in which his side conceded twice at Newcastle would suggest that it would be wise to address Liverpool 's deficiencies in that department.

It is no secret Liverpool have been actively looking in the market for wingers - Bradley Barcola, Ibrahim Mbaye and Yankuba Minteh - and Sunday's display against Newcastle cemented that with Rio Ngumoha looking uncomfortable on the right.

However, the performance also showed Liverpool may need a defensive midfielder to plug the huge disconnect between the defence and midfield, especially on the counter attack.

Liverpool fans have been crying out for a Fabinho replacement since his departure, but it could be too late with a week to go.

Does Elliott have a Liverpool future after latest omission? Published 1 day ago

Does Elliott have a Liverpool future after latest omission?

Manchester City could well be one of the busiest sides to do business in the remaining days of the transfer window.

With Savinho gone and Omar Marmoush and Nico Gonzalez seemingly on their way out, there will be gaps in the squad which will need addressing.

A deal for Ayyoub Bouaddi has been agreed with Lille, and with Palmeiras for winger Allan, while BBC Sport has been told winger Pedro Neto remains of interest and speculation around signing Chelsea team-mate Enzo Fernandez continues.

Director of football Hugo Viana may have his hands full in these coming days.

City need numbers. We have let go of so many players, with Omar Marmoush and maybe Nico Gonzalez set to follow Rodri and Savinho out of the door alongside several others this summer.

It is essential that City bring in three or four new names before the deadline, with two of them being midfielders.

The maths whizz turned Â£86m teenage star heading to Man City Published 2 days ago

The maths whizz turned Â£86m teenage star heading to Man City

Man City agree deal for Palmeiras winger Allan Published 1 day ago

Man City agree deal for Palmeiras winger Allan

Carlos Baleba's arrival completes the midfield recruitment, now all eyes are on the left-back situation and whether Manchester United bring in someone to compete with Luke Shaw.

The club has a long-standing interest in Newcastle 's Lewis Hall, but are also assessing Barcelona's Alejandro Balde and have been heavily linked with Jorge Salinas of Racing Santander.

It is also possible they bring in another forward but that probably depends on one of their existing ones leaving, with Joshua Zirkzee the most likely.

A left-back is essential and this is not just a knee-jerk reaction to the defeat at Hull City - you can see United are short in that position.

We can not realistically expect Luke Shaw to play every game this season and there are still doubts as to whether Michael Carrick trusts Patrick Dorgu in defence.

Baleba completes Â£70m Man Utd move from Brighton Published 8 hours ago

Baleba completes Â£70m Man Utd move from Brighton

Man Utd's midfield spending is done - now for a left-back? Published 8 hours ago

Man Utd's midfield spending is done - now for a left-back?

Newcastle United 's young signings did not look fazed when they faced Liverpool on their Premier League debuts at the weekend.

Manager Matthias Jaissle could still use another midfielder with some top-flight nous, though, after Newcastle sold Bruno Guimaraes and Sandro Tonali, and the club are progressing with a move for Manchester City 's Nico Gonzalez.

Beyond that, bringing in a mobile and versatile forward who could chip in would help ease the burden on William Osula and Yoane Wissa.

Nottingham Forest are still working on deals after only bringing in three new faces so far this summer.

A striker and a full-back would be ideal with the club in talks for Chelsea 's Liam Delap, while Fiorentina right-back Dodo is of interest.

Boss Oliver Glasner has played down the need for midfield reinforcements, despite Elliot Anderson's departure to Manchester City .

Forest working on deal for Chelsea striker Delap Published 1 day ago

Forest working on deal for Chelsea striker Delap

With the signings of French full-back Dayann Methalie from Toulouse and Antwerp midfielder Jules Ahoka over the line, the obvious position Sunderland still need to fill is right wing.

Sporting's Geny Catamo is the name most heavily linked.

Asked about reported interest from the Premier League, Sporting boss Rui Borges insisted Catamo is "happy" at the Portuguese club, but we have seen before that does not necessarily mean much.

Given Eliezer Mayenda has left, meaning Brian Brobbey and Wilson Isidor are the club's only first-team strikers, another forward who plays through the middle is probably needed.

Spurs have strengthened by spending heavily in the summer, but if Dominic Solanke is not going to be used regularly as a main striker, then this is where Roberto de Zerbi must look next.

Richarlison took the starting role in the opening weekend loss at Brentford , and while a deal for Manchester City's Omar Marmoush is progressing , is this actually his best role?

Tottenham desperately need forward players who can turn De Zerbi's quick attacks into decisive moments.

Currently Spurs have the players to play through pressure but don't have the players to maximise the situations this creates.

A winger and a striker who can improve us will be a drastic upgrade.

Get someone like Mudryk in, and I don't think the transfer window could've gone much better for Andrews.

It is anticipated Yankuba Minteh will leave for Liverpool , which might create space at Brighton for another forward and Carlos Baleba's exit for Manchester United may see the club make a move for midfield reinforcements.
It is possible there may be other exits but, as usual, Brighton will stick to their data driven recruitment plan.

"We must continue to evolve, invest and innovate while remaining true to the principles that have brought us this far," was chairman Tony Bloom's message to fans before the 4-0 win against Aston Villa .

With Baleba's anticipated departure and Minteh looking likely that he might leave as well, we need to bring a defensive midfielder who can bring a physical presence to our midfield and a winger who is proven at the top level.
We have a lot of games this season with European football, so we need to have the squad depth to compete on all fronts if we want to secure a top-10 finish again.
Chelsea supporters may want another star forward or a new goalkeeper to replace the unconvincing Robert Sanchez, but Xabi Alonso feels his squad is largely complete for this summer.

However, there is a huge amount of work to do to reduce the squad from 39 players to around 25 within the next eight days. That is the priority, as the Blues will not want frustrated players in their squad this season.
Chelsea need to focus more on the outgoings than incoming players.
With no Europe it's important we do not carry a squad that's too heavy, as we won't have too much room for rotation.
If we were to bring anybody in, I think the priority is a top-drawer goalkeeper.
Coventry are in the hunt for Mykhailo Mudryk as the Chelsea winger looks to get his career back on track after serving a 20 month suspension for testing positive for banned substance meldonium.
Defensive cover is also likely to be needed by Frank Lampard while players like Luke Woolfenden could leave on loan.
Honestly, I think we have done enough in the transfer window to build a team that can stay up in this league.
There has been a lot of change at Palace with the loss of Maxence Lacroix and a new manager starting the season in Pierre Sage.
The Eagles have been building depth for their Europa League campaign but still need a few bodies in the building.

Sage has made clear he wants a senior centre-back and Palace could be pushed to sign another defender too after the injury to Chadi Riad in the first game of the Premier League season against Everton .
Riad's injury has amplified the need for another centre-back who is first-team ready.
Axel Disasi is a good start, but a bigger, permanent move would be great. That, plus a central midfielder, and we are set.
Mateta's contract claim leaves Palace with transfer decision Published 1 day ago
Mateta's contract claim leaves Palace with transfer decision
Everton simply must sign a recognised right-back before the window shuts. It has been a glaring problem for more than a year.
It is a weakness recognised by everyone at the club but either a prime target cannot be agreed upon or is out of reach.
Talented midfielder Merlin Rohl took on the job for the opening game against Crystal Palace, while Jake O'Brien and James Garner have also been pressed into service.
Time to finally make a decision and get one in. Maybe David Moyes will also look at adding another striker with questions still hanging over Beto and Thierno Barry.
Chelsea outcast Liam Delap is one name regularly linked with Everton .
Fulham manager Alvaro Arbeloa has been clear that he is happy with the club's business so far, but more could be done to make his squad more balanced.
There have been attempts to sign an additional central defender, with a move for Rennes' Abdelhamid Ait Boudlal explored two weeks ago, and that could be a key area the Cottagers look to strengthen.
This is a club that does not operate at the very top end of the transfer market and one that enjoys a deadline-day deal.
It still feels like Fulham need a right winger - whether that is sticking with Oscar Bobb or providing serious competition for him - I think we need to cover for the loss of Harry Wilson's goals.
We also need a right-sided centre-back as there are serious concerns over how Joachim Anderson will fit Arbeloa's new system.
It has already been a busy summer for Hull City 's recruitment team but the ambitious Tigers are still working on adding two new forwards in Mohamed Ali-Cho and Ilyas Ansah.

There has also been interest from the club in Real Betis winger Pablo Garcia, although that deal has taken longer than hoped after the La Liga side raised their valuation of the 20-year-old. Stoke City's Sorba Thomas is also a player of interest.
A goalkeeper, midfielder and right-back also could be on the agenda for Sergej Jakirovic's side in the final week of the window.

Over the next week, if we bring in a left winger, one more striker - assuming the Ali-Cho deal also gets completed - a central midfielder, an attacking midfielder and a right-back to add depth and challenge Lewie Coyle for the starting spot, we will be in a strong position to compete.
Ipswich have spent over Â£150m on 12 new signings since returning to the Premier League.
Boss Gary O'Neil expects more, though, and a striker and a midfielder could arrive at Portman Road.
Fringe players like Anis Memeti could leave as O'Neil shapes his squad.
Having pushed the boat out to sign James Trafford from Manchester City , big money signings are probably off the agenda for Leeds in the last week of the window.
They are interested in taking Mykhailo Mudryk on loan but have not been able to strike a deal with the London club as yet as they are looking at other left wingers.

Leeds are also considering back-up options for forwards Dominic Calvert-Lewin and Lukas Nmecha and have also been linked with Frankfurt goalkeeper Michael Zetterer, if Lucas Perri joins Torino on loan as expected.
Leeds have had a great transfer window but they badly need another left-footed left-back as cover for Gabriel Gudmundsson.
Beyond that, perhaps another forward or creative midfielder to contend with Harry Wilson, Brenden Aaronson and Noah Okafor.
As has been the case for most of the summer, Liverpool 's priority remains the wide attacking areas and the expectation is that at least one and maybe two wingers will come in over the coming week.

Andoni Iraola said that personnel was not the issue when it came to defensive midfielders, the manner in which his side conceded twice at Newcastle would suggest that it would be wise to address Liverpool 's deficiencies in that department.

It is no secret Liverpool have been actively looking in the market for wingers - Bradley Barcola, Ibrahim Mbaye and Yankuba Minteh - and Sunday's display against Newcastle cemented that with Rio Ngumoha looking uncomfortable on the right.
However, the performance also showed Liverpool may need a defensive midfielder to plug the huge disconnect between the defence and midfield, especially on the counter attack.
Liverpool fans have been crying out for a Fabinho replacement since his departure, but it could be too late with a week to go.
Does Elliott have a Liverpool future after latest omission? Published 1 day ago
Does Elliott have a Liverpool future after latest omission?
Manchester City could well be one of the busiest sides to do business in the remaining days of the transfer window.
With Savinho gone and Omar Marmoush and Nico Gonzalez seemingly on their way out, there will be gaps in the squad which will need addressing.

A deal for Ayyoub Bouaddi has been agreed with Lille, and with Palmeiras for winger Allan, while BBC Sport has been told winger Pedro Neto remains of interest and speculation around signing Chelsea team-mate Enzo Fernandez continues.
Director of football Hugo Viana may have his hands full in these coming days.
City need numbers. We have let go of so many players, with Omar Marmoush and maybe Nico Gonzalez set to follow Rodri and Savinho out of the door alongside several others this summer.
It is essential that City bring in three or four new names before the deadline, with two of them being midfielders.
The maths whizz turned Â£86m teenage star heading to Man City Published 2 days ago
The maths whizz turned Â£86m teenage star heading to Man City
Man City agree deal for Palmeiras winger Allan Published 1 day ago
Man City agree deal for Palmeiras winger Allan
Carlos Baleba's arrival completes the midfield recruitment, now all eyes are on the left-back situation and whether Manchester United bring in someone to compete with Luke Shaw.
The club has a long-standing interest in Newcastle 's Lewis Hall, but are also assessing Barcelona's Alejandro Balde and have been heavily linked with Jorge Salinas of Racing Santander.
It is also possible they bring in another forward but that probably depends on one of their existing ones leaving, with Joshua Zirkzee the most likely.
A left-back is essential and this is not just a knee-jerk reaction to the defeat at Hull City - you can see United are short in that position.
We can not realistically expect Luke Shaw to play every game this season and there are still doubts as to whether Michael Carrick trusts Patrick Dorgu in defence.
Baleba completes Â£70m Man Utd move from Brighton Published 8 hours ago
Baleba completes Â£70m Man Utd move from Brighton
Man Utd's midfield spending is done - now for a left-back? Published 8 hours ago
Man Utd's midfield spending is done - now for a left-back?
Newcastle United 's young signings did not look fazed when they faced Liverpool on their Premier League debuts at the weekend.

Manager Matthias Jaissle could still use another midfielder with some top-flight nous, though, after Newcastle sold Bruno Guimaraes and Sandro Tonali, and the club are progressing with a move for Manchester City 's Nico Gonzalez.
Beyond that, bringing in a mobile and versatile forward who could chip in would help ease the burden on William Osula and Yoane Wissa.
Nottingham Forest are still working on deals after only bringing in three new faces so far this summer.
A striker and a full-back would be ideal with the club in talks for Chelsea 's Liam Delap, while Fiorentina right-back Dodo is of interest.
Boss Oliver Glasner has played down the need for midfield reinforcements, despite Elliot Anderson's departure to Manchester City .
Forest working on deal for Chelsea striker Delap Published 1 day ago
Forest working on deal for Chelsea striker Delap
With the signings of French full-back Dayann Methalie from Toulouse and Antwerp midfielder Jules Ahoka over the line, the obvious position Sunderland still need to fill is right wing.
Sporting's Geny Catamo is the name most heavily linked.
Asked about reported interest from the Premier League, Sporting boss Rui Borges insisted Catamo is "happy" at the Portuguese club, but we have seen before that does not necessarily mean much.
Given Eliezer Mayenda has left, meaning Brian Brobbey and Wilson Isidor are the club's only first-team strikers, another forward who plays through the middle is probably needed.
Spurs have strengthened by spending heavily in the summer, but if Dominic Solanke is not going to be used regularly as a main striker, then this is where Roberto de Zerbi must look next.
Richarlison took the starting role in the opening weekend loss at Brentford , and while a deal for Manchester City's Omar Marmoush is progressing , is this actually his best role?
Tottenham desperately need forward players who can turn De Zerbi's quick attacks into decisive moments.
Currently Spurs have the players to play through pressure but don't have the players to maximise the situations this creates.
A winger and a striker who can improve us will be a drastic upgrade.

articles.title: El verano de Aday Mara: a días de su estreno con la selección absoluta y mimado por los Thunder
articles.standfirst: El pívot debutará este viernes en las Ventanas FIBA tras haber trabajado con la nueva directora de rendimiento atlético enviada desde Oklahoma
articles.summary: El pívot debutará este viernes en las Ventanas FIBA tras haber trabajado con la nueva directora de rendimiento atlético enviada desde Oklahoma
articles.body: La selección española llegó este lunes a Zaragoza, donde este viernes se mide a Portugal en el estreno de la segunda fase de las Ventanas FIBA de clasificación para la Copa del Mundo que se celebrará en Qatar el próximo año. La cabeza visible del equipo fue Aday Mara y no sólo por sus largos 2,21 metros. También porque el joven pívot hará su debut con la absoluta y será en Zaragoza, donde nació y debutó en la Liga Endesa. Mara ya ha posado con la camiseta roja en la sesión oficial de fotos previa a los partidos y se ha entrenado sobre el parqué del Príncipe Felipe. España se medirá también a Grecia este lunes 31 de agosto. El pívot ha formado parte de algunos combinados de formación y ha subido a podios (platas en el Mundial U17 de 2022 y en el Eurobasket U18 de 2023), pero ahora se encuentra a horas de su primer partido con la absoluta. "Muy feliz de debutar con la selección y luego de poderlo hacer aquí en casa, con amigos, familia y gente que conozco entre el público. Desde que salió que iba a venir a jugar aquí llevo pensándolo, pero intento alejarme lo más posible para que no influya en el partido en entrenos", asegura el pívot en sus primeras palabras desde Zaragoza. El regreso a casa le ha hecho acordarse de sus inicios: "Esos momentos en los que, empezando desde infantiles a alevines, venías a entrenar a la pista de goma y luego tenías que pasar a la de parqué y luego pasabas a la central... Recordar todo eso y el proceso y todas las relaciones que ibas haciendo es algo súper bonito". El pívot de 21 años vive un verano trascendental en su todavía corta carrera en la que ya se proclamó campeón de la NCAA con una Universidad de Míchigan la temporada pasada. Además de su estreno con la absoluta le espera la NBA después de haber sido elegido por los Thunder en el último draft en la duodécima posición. Preparando ese otro debut ha estado trabajando durante varias semanas. Para ayudarle en el proceso de adaptación a la Liga estadounidenses, la franquicia de Oklahoma, campeona en 2025, envió a España a Maral Javadifar, su nueva directora de rendimiento atlético. Se trata de una muestra de la fe y el interés que tienen los Thunder en que Mara pueda desarrollar todo su potencial cuanto antes en la NBA. Lo importante es que mejore su físico y se adapte al vertiginoso ritmo de la competición. Javadifar, que trabajó con el prodigio español durante su estancia en Tenerife, es una profesional muy bien considerada en su ámbito. Durante siete años formó parte de los Tampa Bay Buccaneers de la NFL, campeones de la Super Bowl en 2021. En junio de este año se incorporó a los Thunder y una de sus primeras misiones es dirigir el desarrollo físico de un portento como el de Mara, que ya ha participado en encuentros con su nuevo equipo en la Liga de Verano de la NBA. La primera oportunidad que tendrá el pívot español de mostrar sus evoluciones será este viernes frente a Portugal y en Zaragoza, su casa. Puede ser el inicio de una nueva era en la selección.

articles.title: Oficial: Savinho, nuevo jugador del Tottenham
articles.standfirst: El club de Londres pagará al Manchester City 87 millones de euros más 13 en variables
articles.summary: El club de Londres pagará al Manchester City 87 millones de euros más 13 en variables
articles.body: El Tottenham Hotspur ha llegado a un acuerdo con el Manchester City para el traspaso del internacional brasileño Savinho por 75 millones de libras (87 millones de euros) más 10 en variables (13 millones). Los 'Spurs' se han gastado 330 millones en este mercado de fichajes, a la espera de la llegada del egipcio Omar Marmoush, también del City, por el que pagarán alrededor de 70 millones. El Tottenham ha incorporado este verano a Matheus Fernandes, Sandro Tonali y Jan Paul Van Hecke, en un intento de mejorar las prestaciones de las dos últimas temporadas y volver a competir en Europa. Savinho, de 22 años, llega al Tottenham tras dos años poco fructíferos en el City en los que ha disputado 53 partidos, marcado dos goles y repartido once asistencias. El brasileño, que previamente estuvo cedido en el Girona, ya estuvo cerca de irse al Tottenham el pasado verano, pero los 'Sky Blues' no aceptaron la oferta de 60 millones que recibió. En dos años, el valor de Savinho se ha duplicado. De los 40 millones que pagaron al Troyes, equipo que también pertenece al City Group y en el que Savinho no jugó ni un partido, a los 87 que han ingresado por él este verano y pese a que su rol en el equipo ha sido residual. La venta de Savinho es la más grande en la historia del City, superando por lo que vendieron a Julián Álvarez al Atlético en 2024, estimado en 75 millones de euros más 20 en variables.

articles.title: Savio transfer news: Tottenham sign winger from Manchester City in £85m deal
articles.summary: Savio, formerly known as Savinho, joins Tottenham from Man City in an £85m deal; Spurs will pay an initial £75m for the 22-year-old, with a further £10m available in add-ons; Brazilian's arrival takes Spurs' summer spending past the £300m barrier
articles.body:
Tottenham have confirmed the signing of winger Savio from Manchester City in an £85m deal.

Sky Sports News understands Spurs will pay an initial £75m for the 22-year-old, with a further £10m available in add-ons.

It is understood that £5m of the potential bonuses are effectively guaranteed, meaning City could receive at least £80m from the deal.

  • Transfer Centre LIVE! | Tottenham news & transfers⚪
  • Spurs fixtures & scores | FREE Spurs highlights▶️
  • Got Sky? Watch Premier League games LIVE on your phone📱
  • Not got Sky? Latest Sky Sports deals or stream PL games with no contract📺

Tottenham have finally signed long-term target Savio, formerly known as Savinho at City, after failing to sign the Brazil international last summer. He will wear the No 17 shirt at the club.

The forward previously explained that he adopted the nickname Savinho after it was printed on the back of his shirt after his first call-up to the national team. He kept it following his move from Girona to Manchester City in 2024, but has now reverted back to his actual name.

Savio has been registered in time to make his Tottenham debut against Charlton Athletic in the Carabao Cup third round, live on Sky Sports.

His arrival takes Spurs' spending this summer past the £300m barrier following the arrivals of Sandro Tonali, Mateus Fernandes and Jan Paul van Hecke for a combined fee of £237m. Spurs also added Andy Robertson and Marcos Senesi on free transfers.

Meanwhile, Savio's sale is a club record for Man City, surpassing Julian Alvarez's £82m move to Atletico Madrid in the summer of 2024.

De Zerbi: Savio 'one of the best' one-on-one

Roberto De Zerbi believes Spurs have signed one of the best one-on-one wingers in the world in Savio but to become world class the arrival from City has to add goals to his game.

"I think in attacking positions we need players capable one-on-one, to create something, to create a chance to score," said De Zerbi in a press conference on Tuesday.

"In terms of one-on-one, he's one of the best players, especially since 2024. He can play on the right side, on the left side. I've known him from a long time, I spoke with him when he went to Manchester City. He's a big player for us."

Asked if he is the right man to get the best from him, De Zerbi added: "I don't know if I'm the right man, but for sure he has to achieve. I think a player who is so good in one-on-one, so good at creating chances to score, to be complete, he has to score.

"If you analyse the other best wingers in the world, many of them, they score 10 to 15 goals per season. He has the qualities. Maybe his habits, he has to change habits, because he has to be focused on the assists, the one-on-one dribbling and also to score."

'De Zerbi is one of the best managers in the world,' says Savio

Speaking in a statement released by the club, Savio said: "It's taken a while but I'm very happy to be here.

"It's a wonderful opportunity at a brilliant club with one of the best managers in the world.

"As soon as I spoke to the head coach I knew I had to come. He told me he wants to help me reach the highest level, and I believe we can do that together, as a team."

Spurs boss Roberto De Zerbi added: "Savio is a player who brings energy, imagination and quality in wide positions. He has the courage to attack defenders and the ability to change a game with his creativity.

"We're very pleased to have him with us, and I'm looking forward to working with him, helping him continue to grow and seeing him bring his personality to the team."

Savio secured, Marmoush next?

Sky Sports News reported on Friday that Tottenham are very close to finalising a deal with Manchester City for Omar Marmoush.

Advanced negotiations are ongoing and progressing in the right direction, with Marmoush on board with the move.

However, City head coach Enzo Maresca confirmed that Jeremy Doku has an injury and, with Savio already joining Spurs for £85m, City are currently short of forward options.

Marmoush was an unused substitute during City's 2-1 win against Bournemouth in their Premier League opener but did feature in the Community Shield loss to Arsenal, playing 37 minutes off the bench in the 3-0 defeat.

Spurs are now the Premier League's biggest overspenders

Sky Sports' Sam Blitz and Adam Smith:

Following the £85m signing of Savio from Manchester City, Spurs have now overspent on players by nearly £130m in this summer's transfer window - according to Sky Sports data.

As well as Savio, Spurs have spent £100m on Sandro Tonali, £85m on Mateus Fernandes as well as £52m on Brighton defender Jan Paul Van Hecke.

Sky Sports has compared the transfer fees to each players' value on popular football website Transfermarkt - and Spurs have overspent more than any other Premier League club.

When free transfers are included in the calculations there is a drop-off in the overspending, but not much.

Even allowing for the free signings of Andy Robertson, Marcos Senesi and Martin Dubravka the figure still sits at £101.7m

Savio is also the player who has been overpaid for the most since the start of the window - with the Brazilian signed at £55m over value.

The top three deals for overspending were all Spurs signings in Tonali, Fernandes and Savio.

"It's a wonderful opportunity at a brilliant club with one of the best managers in the world.

"As soon as I spoke to the head coach I knew I had to come. He told me he wants to help me reach the highest level, and I believe we can do that together, as a team."

Spurs boss Roberto De Zerbi added: "Savio is a player who brings energy, imagination and quality in wide positions. He has the courage to attack defenders and the ability to change a game with his creativity.

"We're very pleased to have him with us, and I'm looking forward to working with him, helping him continue to grow and seeing him bring his personality to the team."

Savio secured, Marmoush next?

Sky Sports News reported on Friday that Tottenham are very close to finalising a deal with Manchester City for Omar Marmoush.

Advanced negotiations are ongoing and progressing in the right direction, with Marmoush on board with the move.

However, City head coach Enzo Maresca confirmed that Jeremy Doku has an injury and, with Savio already joining Spurs for £85m, City are currently short of forward options.

Marmoush was an unused substitute during City's 2-1 win against Bournemouth in their Premier League opener but did feature in the Community Shield loss to Arsenal, playing 37 minutes off the bench in the 3-0 defeat.

Spurs are now the Premier League's biggest overspenders

Sky Sports' Sam Blitz and Adam Smith:

Following the £85m signing of Savio from Manchester City, Spurs have now overspent on players by nearly £130m in this summer's transfer window - according to Sky Sports data.

As well as Savio, Spurs have spent £100m on Sandro Tonali, £85m on Mateus Fernandes as well as £52m on Brighton defender Jan Paul Van Hecke.

Sky Sports has compared the transfer fees to each players' value on popular football website Transfermarkt - and Spurs have overspent more than any other Premier League club.

When free transfers are included in the calculations there is a drop-off in the overspending, but not much.

Even allowing for the free signings of Andy Robertson, Marcos Senesi and Martin Dubravka the figure still sits at £101.7m

Savio is also the player who has been overpaid for the most since the start of the window - with the Brazilian signed at £55m over value.

The top three deals for overspending were all Spurs signings in Tonali, Fernandes and Savio.

articles.title: Venta récord en Portugal: Müller, Hummels y Sommer compran el Estrela da Amadora por 40 millones
articles.standfirst: Un grupo inversor alemán, entre los que destacan los tres exjugadores de la Bundesliga, ha apostado por este club lisboeta de la Primera División
articles.summary: Un grupo inversor alemán, entre los que destacan los tres exjugadores de la Bundesliga, ha apostado por este club lisboeta de la Primera División
articles.body: El fútbol de Portugal está camino de vivir una revolución. El atractivo por sus clubes no deja de crecer, y ya no sólo se trata de los grandes. El Estrela da Amadora, que ascendió a Primera División en 2024, acaba de ser vendido por 40 millones de euros, un récord para una SAD de la liga lusa. ¿El motivo? Varios, pero, particularmente, la venta centralizada de los derechos de televisión, un déficit histórico del país vecino, que arrancará en 2028 y tiene como objetivo ayudar a nivelar a medio plazo una de las ligas más desequilibras en ingresos de toda Europa. El comprador es un grupo inversor alemán entre cuyos socios se encuentran tres leyendas de la Bundesliga: Thomas Muller, Mats Hummels y Yan Sommer. Al frente de la SAD, que controlará el 90% –el 10% restante seguirá en manos del club–, se prevé que esté Johannes Mösmang, un joven ejecutivo de 35 años con experiencia en el FC Bayern. Asimismo, la operación remarca el acierto de quienes invirtieron en el fútbol portugués hace unos años, cuando todavía se discutía si centralizar o no los derechos audiovisuales. Paulo Lopo compró el Estrela da Amadora en 2020, en plena pandemia y con el equipo en Tercera División. Pagó 72.000 euros. Ahora lo vende valorado en 40 millones. La inversión alemana en el Estrela da Amadora se une a la que han hecho holdings y grandes empresarios en los últimos años en el país: QSI, dueño del PSG, adquirió una participación en el Sporting de Braga; V Sports, dueño del Aston Villa, hizo lo mismo en el Vitória de Guimaraes; Evangelos Marinakis, propietario del Nottingham Forest y del Olympiacos, compró el Rio Ave; incluso Vinícius Jr. se sumó a este boom inversor con el FC Alverca. Desde España, los dos últimos en apostar por el fútbol del país vecino provienen de Galicia: Grupo Élite, que controla el Racing Club de Ferrol y tiene como presidente al empresario Ignacio Rivera (Estrella Galicia), compró el año pasado el CD Tondela, mientras que Juan Carlos Escotet, máximo accionista del RC Deportivo a través de Abanca, adquirió pocos meses después el FC Penafiel.
