articles.title: 8 Hot Takes for the 2026 College Football Season
articles.summary: The road to arrive here, on the cusp of a fresh college football season, has been long. But despite the long, painful wait, a new batch of games, upsets, disappointments and moments are at our doorstep.
articles.body:
The road to arrive here, on the cusp of a fresh college football season, has been long. But despite the long, painful wait, a new batch of games, upsets, disappointments and moments are at our doorstep.

With the start of every college football season comes a flood of takes. Let's be honest, everyone wants to be right. Many will be wrong. Such is the life of trying to unpack how a season will play out.

Here, we're not delivering layup predictions. What's the point in that?

No, we're searching for the hottest of takes as the season begins, looking for hot takes that will withstand the test of time.

Let us begin. And welcome back, football. We missed you dearly.

Bill Belichick Won't Be North Carolina Head Coach Come New Year's Day

From the moment he was announced as head coach, the fit has never been right.

The program has dealt with organizational uncertainty. His handpicked general manager, Michael Lombardi, was placed on paid administrative leave . Steve Belichick, his son and the team's defensive coordinator, was placed on medical leave .

And the results, so far, haven't been there. UNC won four games in 2025, and there's not an abundance of optimism heading into this year. Maybe the Tar Heels will win five games. Heck, maybe they become bowl-eligible under the best of circumstances.

The reality is it just won't matter. Belichick is 74 years old, and another season of middling football with so many moving pieces just won't work. Maybe he leaves, maybe he's asked to leave or maybe it's a combination of the two.

Yes, Belichick is likely out, one way or another. Other coaches will be, too. Such is the ritual in the sport, but don't expect an avalanche of coaching changes throughout.

As the winds of college football have swirled over these past few offseasons, something strange has happened. College football coaches are no longer being removed—especially from high-profile jobs—at the pace they once were.

Sure, changes happen. Auburn, Florida and LSU, three enormous jobs, have new coaches. There was movement last year, and there will be once again.

But with schools struggling to balance budgets due to NIL and other unique constraints, the prospect of paying enormous buyouts is causing schools to reconsider making a change.

Last season, Wisconsin and Florida State followed this path. This year, other schools in a crunch will hesitate to pull the trigger, choosing instead to reinvest in the roster.

There will still be firings, but don't expect the flurry we were once accustomed to.

Oklahoma State Will Execute One of the Greatest CFB Turnarounds in Recent Memory

You no longer need three years to turn a program around. Curt Cignetti showed us this, lifting Indiana to unreasonable heights over a few short months.

Oklahoma State might not reach that level of success in Eric Morris' first season, but there is a ton to like. The former North Texas coach is bringing Drew Mestemaker and Caleb Hawkins with him, giving him stars at quarterback and running back.

And for as bad as things were with the Pokes' roster last season, a rebuilt lineup and a friendly conference schedule make the potential that much more intriguing.

An early matchup against Oregon might not go spectacularly, although things will improve as the season progresses. It wouldn't be the least bit shocking to see OK State go from Big 12 doormat to conference Cinderella—a potential threat to make the College Football Playoff—in one season.

Trinidad Chambliss Will Become the Face of College Football

A year ago, Trinidad Chambliss was an unknown backup quarterback who had just transferred in from Ferris State, figuring to be somewhere deep on the Ole Miss depth chart.

Now, he's the most electrifying player in football, ready for an encore.

Forget about the word "best" for a moment. In a year with so many capable quarterbacks at massive programs, Chambliss is very much in contention for this prestigious honor.

In many respects, however, he is more than that. He is a passer, he is a runner, he is a creator. His game is explosive and unpredictable. He is charismatic without being dramatic, which speaks volumes given the coach he previously played for.

Simply put, no player warrants your attention more on a given play than this one. And now that he's gotten comfortable with his school and new head coach, the best is still yet to come.

Speaking of Ole Miss, enter Lane Kiffin.

Given his high-profile departure from the Rebels and his headline-capturing arrival at LSU, Kiffin has largely been at the epicenter of college football over the past nine months.

Since arriving in Baton Rouge, however, Kiffin has managed to assemble a spectacular roster, putting LSU's ample resources to use.

Which leads us to the actual games, the only thing that matters.

Indeed, LSU's schedule is a mess. The Tigers play five opponents currently ranked in the Top 25 in the preseason AP Poll. They also play Clemson and take a tricky road game at Auburn.

It's a lot to ask out of a head coach still learning his roster, albeit one with plenty of talented options. But with Sam Leavitt at QB and talent at key positions, Kiffin will find a way.

No, LSU won't win a national championship. But the Tigers will be a force in the SEC and find a home in the playoff in Kiffin's debut voyage.

2026 Will Be Year of the Running Back, Not the Quarterback

To be clear, the quarterbacks across college football are exceptional. Dante Moore, Arch Manning, Julian Sayin, CJ Carr, Darian Mensah and Trinidad Chambliss, just to name a few, will be as advertised.

But at a time when NFL teams have shown a renewed willingness to invest in elite running backs, college football will follow suit. And the talent level across the country warrants it.

Ole Miss' Kewan Lacy and Missouri's Ahmad Hardy are the lead backs. The hope, of course, is that Hardy is healthy enough to be the ridiculous talent we know he can be. Beyond him, however, the list is deep.

Miami's March Fletcher Jr. was a CFB playoff star. BYU's LJ Martin was a monster last year. Louisville's Isaac Brown, Oklahoma State's Caleb Hawkins, Florida's Jadan Baugh, Ohio State's Bo Jackson, Texas' Hollywood Smothers and plenty of others will have an enormous say on how this year plays out.

The SEC Will Again Play Its Way Out of the CFB Playoff

First, some clarity: This is not a knock on the SEC. In fact, it's quite the opposite.

The exhausting dialogue that comes when comparing conferences based on results is tiresome, and that is not the intent here.

The reality, however, is that the SEC gauntlet will continue. What we saw at the end of last season, with Texas and Vanderbilt on the outside looking in, will persist. There will be more fan bases in the SEC crying foul come final playoff rankings, and there will be a strong case to be made that those teams deserve a spot.

A nine-game conference schedule won't help matters—not with teams in the middle and the bottom half of the conference set to improve. As a result of this depth, there will be far fewer teams with two or fewer losses at season's end.

That result will create a familiar debate, one the SEC will be on the wrong side of once again.

Is that fair? Absolutely not, but it's the system we have.

Oregon Will Win Its First National Championship

Under Chip Kelly, the Ducks were so close to winning a title. Many years later, under Dan Lanning, all the necessary pieces have properly aligned.

The quarterback is back, for starters. Dante Moore's decision to forego the NFL Draft was the major piece, and his supporting cast is nothing short of remarkable. His wideouts are healthy, and it might be the best collection of pass catchers in the country.

But the defense is where this pick really takes shape. The defensive line is loaded, the defensive backfield has reloaded and there are future NFL players all over the field.

Navigating the Big Ten, which includes a road trip to Ohio State, has plenty of teeth. But the Ducks' goals stretch well beyond that game. The roster and coaching staff are in place. The talent is overwhelming.

This has the makings of a truly elite college football team. Let the games begin.

articles.title: El plan B del Barça a Julián
articles.standfirst: No fichará y Flick se queda con lo que tiene salvo una improbable oportunidad de mercado
articles.summary: No fichará y Flick se queda con lo que tiene salvo una improbable oportunidad de mercado
articles.body: El Atlético de Madrid no da su brazo a torcer y se mantiene firme en su postura de no vender a Julián Álvarez al Barcelona. A pesar de que la situación en el club rojiblanco es insostenible después de la reacción de la grada en el partido del pasado fin de semana contra el Villarreal, Gil Marín y Mateu Alemany lo tienen claro. Están dispuestos a venderlo al Arsenal, pero no al Barcelona. En el club azulgrana ya tienen claro que no podrán incorporar al delantero. Ya se lo olían desde hacía tiempo porque han visto que la postura del Atlético es firme, a pesar de la presión que ha ejercido el futbolista desde que, durante el Mundial, hiciera unas declaraciones públicas dejando claro que lo mejor era un traspaso. Y la imposibilidad de fichar al argentino abre un nuevo escenario. El Barça activará el plan B, pero este no será fichar a ningún jugador. Flick y Deco han decidido no incorporar a un delantero en este mercado estival. Salvo que se produjera una oportunidad de mercado de última hora, el Barça se queda como está. Son conscientes de que esa oportunidad no se va a producir cuando nos encontramos a una semana del cierre del mercado. Porque esa oportunidad tendría que ser un jugador de alto nivel. La Dirección Deportiva tiene claro que no van a traer una medianía. Si viene alguien, tiene que ser un delantero potente, y es muy difícil que, con tan poco tiempo, un club venda a uno de sus mejores jugadores porque apenas tendría tiempo para encontrar un recambio. Por tanto, el Barça se va a quedar como está. Una de las razones para tomar esta decisión es lo que ha visto Flick en la pretemporada y en el primer partido oficial contra el Elche. El alemán está contento con lo que tiene en ataque, teniendo en cuenta que sus jugadores pueden actuar en varias posiciones ofensivas, como se ha demostrado en estos partidos. En Elche, Raphinha hizo un partidazo. Para la posición de delantero centro que ocupó el brasileño en el último partido, hay varios futbolistas que pueden jugar también. Gordon y Adeyemi, los dos fichajes, aunque son dos extremos, pueden hacerlo en el centro del ataque. El alemán ya lo ha hecho en pretemporada. Y Dani Olmo también está perfectamente capacitado para actuar en esa posición. Y no hay que olvidar a los jóvenes. Hamza Abdelkarim ha sido el máximo goleador de la pretemporada y apunta muy buenas maneras. También Bisiwu, que, aunque ha jugado menos, ha demostrado que tiene gol. Flick está tranquilo con lo que tiene y de ahí que no fuerce para traer un delantero. Y, si la cosa no funciona, en enero siempre se podría fichar.

articles.title: Tchouaméni, Endrick y Asencio siguen fuera
articles.standfirst: Lista de Mou para la Real con hasta siete bajas y tres canteranos: Rivas, Cestero y Ciria
articles.summary: Lista de Mou para la Real con hasta siete bajas y tres canteranos: Rivas, Cestero y Ciria
articles.body: José Mourinho ha dado este martes la segunda lista oficial de la temporada. Una convocatoria en la que de nuevo se quedaron fuera Tchouaméni y Endrick, que siguen arrastrando distintos problemas físicos. Completan la citación del técnico blanco tres canteranos: Mario Rivas, Cestero y Alexis Ciria. Tchouaméni lleva arrastrando molestias desde su regreso de las vacaciones de las que disfrutó tras el Mundial. Apenas ha tenido la oportunidad de dejarse ver junto al resto de sus compañeros, y volverá a ser baja en el próximo partido de los blancos. Por su parte, Endrick está siguiendo un plan personalizado para evitar problemas físicos a lo largo de la temporada. En el club quieren evitar que se repitan situaciones como las de la pasada temporada durante su cesión en el Lyon, cuando se vio obligado a parar en varias ocasiones debido a problemas musculares. articles.title: Kochorashvili: "Los valores de este club van en conjunto con cómo soy"
articles.standfirst: El centrocampista georgiano aseguró que "la adaptación está siendo fácil"
articles.summary: El centrocampista georgiano aseguró que "la adaptación está siendo fácil"
articles.body: El Sevilla ha presentado este martes a su última incorporación, Giorgi Kochorashvili, que compartió comparecencia con Robbie Ure. "Agradezco todo el esfuerzo para que esté aquí. Han sido días intensos, pero estoy muy contento en el sitio en el que de pequeño me imaginaba jugar, en un gran club. La adaptación está siendo fácil. He podido hablar con los chicos y todos están comprometidos para lograr el objetivo", explicaba el centrocampista georgiano procedente del Sporting de Portugal, que firma con la entidad blanquirroja hasta 2030. ¿Por qué el Sevilla?. "Me han transmitido mucho los valores de este club gente que jugó aquí como Coke o Campaña, y van en conjunto con cómo soy yo". Trabajo en su día libre. "Llevaba tres días sin entrenar, dije que me gustaría hacerlo y la gente del club me lo facilitaron mucho. Hay que valorar esas cosas del club y agradecerles a ellos el esfuerzo. Estamos aquí para estar al máximo y eso empieza trabajando hasta en los días libres". Objetivos. "Pienso mucho en el presente y para mí el objetivo es el partido contra el Atlético de Madrid y hacerlo bien". Aportación al equipo. "Ojalá que no haya tantos nervios, pero al final tenemos bastante experiencia de los momentos buenos y los malos. Ayudaré en todo lo que se pueda a los que estén a mi lado". Posición preferida."Es difícil responder porque siempre digo que estaré donde el equipo me necesite. Todos sabemos que mi fuerza está jugando como 8; tengo llegada, puedo ayudar a defender, tener la pelota y creo que la respuesta es esa. Pero jugaré donde el equipo y el míster me necesiten". Afición. "De momento no he jugado en casa y estoy deseando salir y ver todo ese apoyo, porque en las calles veo muy buenas sensaciones. Quiero ver el sábado a todos juntos en el campo y sentir ese ambiente del que todos me han hablado". Tiempos del fichaje. "Soy una persona tranquila y lo he vivido tranquilo, aunque siempre está esa preocupación por el futuro. Estoy muy feliz de estar. Cuando era niño, en Georgia no se veían muchos partidos, pero sí los de Madrid, Barcelona, Sevilla... y en mi mente ya estaba venir. Estoy aquí para poder representar a todos esos niños de Georgia que tienen el sueño de jugar en un club tan grande como el Sevilla". Carlos Álvarez. "Hablo mucho con Carlitos porque en el Levante encajé muy bien con él dentro y fuera del campo. Es muy intenso, un amigo muy cercano, pero al final el fútbol siempre tiene diferentes destinos. Vamos a ver qué pasa en el futuro, pero le dije que algún día terminaríamos jugando juntos porque disfruté mucho en el campo con él". Qué espera del Sevilla. "El fútbol me ha dado todo y el Sevilla me ha dado la oportunidad de estar aquí. Tengo que devolverlo y depende de mí, no puedo pedirle nada al Sevilla".

articles.title: El Getafe ingresará más de medio millón por Santi García
articles.standfirst: El futbolista, una de las figuras en este inicio de temporada en Portugal, interesa al Anderlecht
articles.summary: El futbolista, una de las figuras en este inicio de temporada en Portugal, interesa al Anderlecht
articles.body: El gran nivel de Santi García no ha pasado desapercibido en los últimos meses. Esto, sumado al gran inicio de temporada con el Gil Vicente, ha avivado los pretendientes por el jugador salido de la cantera de Trival Valderas y Getafe. Del conjunto azulón salía en dirección a Portugal, donde, en apenas dos temporadas, se ha hecho dueño y señor de la zona de creación de un Gil Vicente que ha recibido intereses de LaLiga y de fuera. Ahora, en concreto, el Anderlecht es el equipo que está pujando más fuerte y, según informan en Portugal, podrían alcanzar los once millones de euros por el futbolista español. Todo ello hace que el Getafe esté a la espera de acontecimientos, a sabiendas de que, pase lo que pase, va a recibir algo más de medio millón por el futbolista. En caso de que finalmente Santi siga en el cuadro luso, este abonará esa cantidad al conjunto madrileño, que aún tiene un porcentaje, para hacerse con el 100% del futbolista. Los azulones, que aún guardan esos derechos, también se verían beneficiados en caso de venta. Una venta que, si se llega a las cifras que ha puesto Gil Vicente a Anderlecht y demás interesados, reportaría una cantidad parecida en las arcas azulonas, que tendrían esa inyección económica extra en pleno mercado.

articles.title: Carlos Álvarez, preparado para hacer las maletas
articles.standfirst: El jugador del Levante tiene el interés del extranjero que estarían dispuestos a cerrar una operación necesaria para las cuentas granotas
articles.summary: El jugador del Levante tiene el interés del extranjero que estarían dispuestos a cerrar una operación necesaria para las cuentas granotas
articles.body: La ausencia de Carlos Álvarez en El Sadar no ha pasado desapercibida para nadie. El jugador andaluz es una de las grandes perlas del Levante y un nombre propio marcado en rojo para que los del barrio de Orriols puedan hacer caja en este mercado de verano. Ni las autorizadas explicaciones que argumentó Luís Castro tras el partido ante Osasuna han caído en saco roto. El entrador granota explicó que la ausencia del atacante en el choque era “por una decisión personal, ya que necesitábamos otra cosa”. Seguidamente, matizó que “todos los jugadores del Levante, y yo también, estamos preparados para salir”. Ante este escenario, según ha adelantado RADIO MARCA Valencia y ha podido confirmar MARCA, la entidad granota espera una oferta por el jugador en los próximos días de un equipo extranjero. Así mismo, tanto Carlos Álvarez como el club, que son conscientes de esta situación, confirmarían su marcha si llega una oferta consensuada. El mediapunta de Sanlucar la Mayor, aterrizó en el Ciutat de Valencia en el verano de 2023, con el equipo en Segunda División, a coste cero procedente del Sevilla FC. Tras dos temporadas en la categoría de plata, donde mostró un rendimiento extraordinario, y un notable rendimiento en primera el curso pasado, el andaluz termina contrato en 2027 y a día de hoy no existe ningún tipo de negociación de renovación. Otro de los detalles, a destacar, de esta posible operación. Es que el cuadro hispalense se quedaría el 40% de una posible venta, aunque a partir de esta presente temporada, esa cantidad se rebajaría hasta el 30%.

articles.title: Matteo Prati, a un paso del Racing
articles.standfirst: La duda es el si el eje del Cagliari llegaría al Racing en calidad de cedido o en propiedad
articles.summary: La duda es el si el eje del Cagliari llegaría al Racing en calidad de cedido o en propiedad
articles.body: Chema Aragón, director deportivo del Racing reconocía en rueda de prensa de presentación de Iván Martín que Matteo Prati estaba prácticamente cerrado como nuevo futbolista del conjunto cántabro. Aragón dejaba claro que la negociación por el futbolista italiano se remonta al final de la pasada campaña, ' “Empezamos a hablar el 2 de junio y tuvimos que esperar tiempo para lo que nos hubiera gustado' . El futbolista de 22 años, que en la primera jornada de la Seie A no ha jugado con el Cagliari, está en negociaciones con el Racing ya desde la semana pasada, pero hasta ahora su fichaje no se había concretado. La duda es el si el eje del Cagliari llegaría al Racing en calidad de cedido o en propiedad. El conjunto cántabro quiere guardarse una opción de compra en caso que llegase a préstamo. Matteo Prati de 22 años es futbolista que mide 1,85 centímetros, juega de eje posicional. La pasada temporada, en el mercado invernal, estuvo cedido (con opción de compra) en el Torino, también de la Serie A, aunque con un rol más discreto. Tiene contrato con su club hasta 2028. Chema Aragón analizó la situación de Sergio Martínez por el cual se ha interesado el Real Madrid. El director deportivo del Racing dejaba claro como está su posible salida. "El chico está entrenando mejor que nunca; y claro que influye lo que haga en estos partidos y es normal que tenga dudas", explicó, al tiempo que admitió que "cuando me preguntan digo que está el Real Madrid pero también está el Racing, que si le garantizara lo que tiene ahora, ser titular, seguro que se quedaría aquí". Sergio Martínez cuenta con una cláusula de rescisión de 3 millones de euros.

articles.title: Fantasy Football Running Back Scouting Reports: A preview of some of the RB profiles in the Yahoo Fantasy Ultra Playbook
articles.summary: Fantasy football analyst Joel Smyth gives a sneak peek at some of his RB profiles, available in the Yahoo Fantasy Ultra Playbook.
articles.body:
The 2026 NFL season is fast approaching and the Yahoo Fantasy Ultra Playbook has everything you need to know to before your draft, giving you the tools and analysis to crush the competition. Among that analysis is Joel Smyth's RB player profiles. Below is a sneak peek of some of the 25+ rusher profiles in the Ultra Playbook, including a ceiling and risk meter for each. If you subscribe to Ultra, there are nearly 150 player profiles to digest.

Get a free preview of what Ultra subscribers get with The Playbook, including a snapshot of our sleepers, breakouts, strategy tips, player profiles and more, right here.

Ceiling: If things fall in their favor, how big can they hit in 2026?

Risk: A subjective ranking based on injuries, surrounding injuries, coaching changes, how proven a player is, age, and other factors that bring on uncertainty

It's night and day for Kenneth Walker III in terms of his fantasy situation. He goes from an offense with a split backfield, and little work in the red zone, to a team whose offense is both high-scoring and lacking weapons. His contract and competition makes predicting top-12 RB volume reasonable, with opportunities in the red zone and passing game being key additions.

The fantasy obstacle for Walker has always been injuries. Although he's only missed 10 of 72 career games, only 41 of those games have come with 15+ touches due to leaving early, snap counts and coaching decisions. The 23.4 fantasy PPG in the NFL Playoffs last season is what fantasy managers hope will be what sticks from 2025. After the failed Isiah Pacheco-Kareem Hunt experiment, Andy Reid will look to go back to having a workhorse in Walker.

Can Daniel Jones come back strong? Taylor's production fell off after his quarterback's Achilles injury in 2025, production that started out as part of the No. 1 scoring offense in the NFL with a run-first mentality. JT is the definition of a bellcow RB, with underrated, career-high usage in the passing game last season. If Jones' injury causes less QB red-zone rushing and more checkdowns, Taylor could top his 2025 season easily as long as the offense can remain clicking. As one of only four running backs to be an RB1 in three consecutive seasons, he should be in for another RB1 season with high volume.

Before the J.K. Dobbins injury, the Broncos' rookie RB only handled 24% of RB carries last season. He was a TD machine that broke out in the second half of the season as the starter, although it diminished after Week 17 (the fantasy championship in most leagues). The return of Dobbins and addition of fourth-round pick Jonah Coleman makes it a more difficult path for Harvey to return to his peak. The offensive line and receiving opportunity are great, but the Broncos RB will just need to develop after a rookie season that was shaky in efficiency.

The concern is obvious: Henderson barely played in the NFL playoffs when it matters most. Four total snaps in the AFC Championship is #notgood. He is a big "if" player. If he gets 50% of the volume, that alone can be enough. If he gets 65%+ he can be a league winner. We saw it in spurts with three different top-five RB weeks alone, specifically posting RB1 numbers in his month without Rhamondre Stevenson, at 20 touches a week. His overall rushing efficiency and pass protection were sub-par, but it was his rookie season after all. If he can flirt with 15 touches per game, that'll be plenty to hit ADP in a New England offense.

Rumors of a running back by committee can hurt Pollard in a big way. Surprisingly, the Titans RB is one of three RBs to have 275+ carries in three straight seasons. Although he was relevantly efficient in 2025, the Tennessee offense held him back from any real fantasy payout. However, he has been a top-30 RB in each of the last four seasons, and should make it five if the Titans offense improves after overhauling that side of the ball.

Ben Johnson running backs have scored more than any since 2022, but Swift's production, especially in the second half of the season, surprisingly was limited to the ground game. He tied his career high in goal-line attempts but averaged a career low in targets. With Kyle Monangai increasing his workload later in the year, Swift should be an RB2 thanks to an elite rushing attack, yet with a lower ceiling compared to past seasons.

Nobody had a better offseason than 2025 fourth-rounder Bhayshul Tuten. After rumors of adding a top running back in the draft or free agency, the Jacksonville Jaguars replaced Travis Etienne Jr. with career backup Chris Rodriguez Jr. and passed on the position with all 10 of their NFL Draft selections. The volume is the X-Factor and the unknown.

If Jacksonville does use Tuten as a true 1A, he can be the biggest fantasy value in the draft. Tuten and Rodriguez both have the same strengths as inside runners and were dominant at the goal line in 2025. When it comes to receiving, Tuten has the clear advantage, although he was far behind Etienne in that department last season. With a top offense to support him and playcaller Liam Coen having the fifth-most RB fantasy points the last two seasons, Tuten is a high-upside target.

Warren is a reliable fantasy option that isn't always the most exciting draft-day selection. His efficiency has always been high, with the volume being the main eluding factor. In the Aaron Rodgers offense, RBs score plenty with a vast amount of targets available. Based on targets per route and yards per route, no RB was more efficient than Warren in 2025. Now that he's back healthy and without Kenny Gainwell, that passing involvement could be the key to fantasy success if he can beat out Rico Dowdle for that primary role.

He goes from an offense with a split backfield, and little work in the red zone, to a team whose offense is both high-scoring and lacking weapons. His contract and competition makes predicting top-12 RB volume reasonable, with opportunities in the red zone and passing game being key additions.

The fantasy obstacle for Walker has always been injuries. Although he's only missed 10 of 72 career games, only 41 of those games have come with 15+ touches due to leaving early, snap counts and coaching decisions. The 23.4 fantasy PPG in the NFL Playoffs last season is what fantasy managers hope will be what sticks from 2025. After the failed Isiah Pacheco-Kareem Hunt experiment, Andy Reid will look to go back to having a workhorse in Walker.

Can Daniel Jones come back strong? Taylor's production fell off after his quarterback's Achilles injury in 2025, production that started out as part of the No. 1 scoring offense in the NFL with a run-first mentality. JT is the definition of a bellcow RB, with underrated, career-high usage in the passing game last season. If Jones' injury causes less QB red-zone rushing and more checkdowns, Taylor could top his 2025 season easily as long as the offense can remain clicking. As one of only four running backs to be an RB1 in three consecutive seasons, he should be in for another RB1 season with high volume.

Before the J.K. Dobbins injury, the Broncos' rookie RB only handled 24% of RB carries last season. He was a TD machine that broke out in the second half of the season as the starter, although it diminished after Week 17 (the fantasy championship in most leagues). The return of Dobbins and addition of fourth-round pick Jonah Coleman makes it a more difficult path for Harvey to return to his peak. The offensive line and receiving opportunity are great, but the Broncos RB will just need to develop after a rookie season that was shaky in efficiency.

The concern is obvious: Henderson barely played in the NFL playoffs when it matters most. Four total snaps in the AFC Championship is #notgood. He is a big "if" player. If he gets 50% of the volume, that alone can be enough. If he gets 65%+ he can be a league winner. We saw it in spurts with three different top-five RB weeks alone, specifically posting RB1 numbers in his month without Rhamondre Stevenson, at 20 touches a week. His overall rushing efficiency and pass protection were sub-par, but it was his rookie season after all. If he can flirt with 15 touches per game, that'll be plenty to hit ADP in a New England offense.

Rumors of a running back by committee can hurt Pollard in a big way. Surprisingly, the Titans RB is one of three RBs to have 275+ carries in three straight seasons. Although he was relevantly efficient in 2025, the Tennessee offense held him back from any real fantasy payout. However, he has been a top-30 RB in each of the last four seasons, and should make it five if the Titans offense improves after overhauling that side of the ball.

Ben Johnson running backs have scored more than any since 2022, but Swift's production, especially in the second half of the season, surprisingly was limited to the ground game. He tied his career high in goal-line attempts but averaged a career low in targets. With Kyle Monangai increasing his workload later in the year, Swift should be an RB2 thanks to an elite rushing attack, yet with a lower ceiling compared to past seasons.

Nobody had a better offseason than 2025 fourth-rounder Bhayshul Tuten. After rumors of adding a top running back in the draft or free agency, the Jacksonville Jaguars replaced Travis Etienne Jr. with career backup Chris Rodriguez Jr. and passed on the position with all 10 of their NFL Draft selections. The volume is the X-Factor and the unknown.

If Jacksonville does use Tuten as a true 1A, he can be the biggest fantasy value in the draft. Tuten and Rodriguez both have the same strengths as inside runners and were dominant at the goal line in 2025. When it comes to receiving, Tuten has the clear advantage, although he was far behind Etienne in that department last season. With a top offense to support him and playcaller Liam Coen having the fifth-most RB fantasy points the last two seasons, Tuten is a high-upside target.

Warren is a reliable fantasy option that isn't always the most exciting draft-day selection. His efficiency has always been high, with the volume being the main eluding factor. In the Aaron Rodgers offense, RBs score plenty with a vast amount of targets available. Based on targets per route and yards per route, no RB was more efficient than Warren in 2025. Now that he's back healthy and without Kenny Gainwell, that passing involvement could be the key to fantasy success if he can beat out Rico Dowdle for that primary role.

articles.title: Livakovic ya está en Barcelona
articles.standfirst: Está previsto que este miércoles pase la revisión médica
articles.summary: Está previsto que este miércoles pase la revisión médica
articles.body: Dominik Livakovic ya se encuentra en Barcelona. El nuevo portero del equipo azulgrana aterrizó a media tarde con el fin de incorporarse cuanto antes a la disciplina azulgrana. Esta previsto que el guardameta pase la revisión médica este miércoles y a partir de ahí se producirá el anuncio oficial. El club ha cambiado su idea respecto a Livakovic. En un principio, querían cederlo una temporada para que se incorporase al Barcelona en la 27/28, una vez que Szczesny finalizara su contrato. Sin embargo, todo hace indicar que se incorporará de inmediato al equipo de Flick y la plantilla tendrá tres porteros: Joan García, Szczesny y Livakovic. A su llegada a Barcelona, no quiso pronunciarse sobre esta posibilidad. "Ya veremos", dijo cuando fue cuestionado al respecto. Lo que sí aseguro que es está "muy feliz" por su incorporación al Barcelona.

articles.title: Carlos Baleba: Manchester United sign Cameroon midfielder from Brighton in Â£70m deal
articles.summary: Manchester United sign Cameroon midfielder Carlos Baleba from Brighton in a Â£70m deal.
articles.body:
Manchester United have signed Cameroon midfielder Carlos Baleba from Brighton in a Â£70m deal.

The Old Trafford club have paid an initial Â£65m, plus a potential Â£5m in add-ons, for the 22-year-old, while Brighton have negotiated a sell-on clause.

United targeted Baleba after deciding to strengthen their midfield further following the summer arrivals of Andrey Santos from Chelsea and Youri Tielemans from Aston Villa .

Baleba has signed a five year-contract at Old Trafford, with the option to extend for a further year.

"It is an incredible feeling to join the club of my dreams," he said. "Playing at Old Trafford is always special, but the opportunity to do so as a Manchester United player will be a real honour.

"I cannot wait to work with Michael Carrick. His experience and knowledge of the game make him the perfect coach to help me to reach the highest level.

"The ambition of everyone at the club is extremely clear, the future is hugely exciting, and I am determined to play my part in delivering the success that we are capable of together."

Baleba's move follows United's shock 2-0 defeat by Hull City in Saturday's Premier League opener, where Santos and Tielemans made their midfield debuts.

United reignited their interest after attempting to sign him last year near deadline day, but were put off by Brighton 's valuation, which was in excess of Â£100m.

Baleba, who joined Brighton from Lille in 2023, is currently sidelined with an ankle injury he picked up during the Seagulls' pre-season training camp in Austria.

He made 112 appearances for Brighton , scoring four times, and 31 in the Premier League last season as they finished eighth to qualify for this season's Conference League.

"Last season was hard," admitted Baleba in a farewell video.

"There was a night against Aston Villa when I came off after 22 minutes. I sat in the dugout and could not lift my head up. You did not boo me. I have thought about that more than you know. You had every reason to and you did not.

"I will be looking for your result every week for the rest of my life. Thank you, Brighton fans."

The move has taken United's summer spending up to Â£153m as they prepare for a return to the Champions League for the first time since the 2023-24 campaign.

"[He is] a huge talent that the club has been trying to follow for a long time." Red Devils captain Bruno Fernandes told BBC Radio 5 Live. "Someone that can improve our team and has different qualities to what we already have in the club.

"The expectation is very high but also we know he is a player we need to give time to become an even better version of himself. We are here to help him set [in] as quick as possible and to help us win games."

What does your Premier League club still need in the transfer window? Published 8 hours ago

What does your Premier League club still need in the transfer window?

United will hope for the 2024-25 version of Baleba rather than last season's because it was his performances in that campaign that attracted them.

We can't know what would have happened if the approach for Mateus Fernandes had been successful, nor if Mason Mount had not suffered the injury in the pre-season game with Paris St-Germain two weeks ago that ruled him out of the Premier League opener.

However, even before Saturday's disappointing loss at Hull it is clear that, despite adding Santos and Tielemans to their midfield ranks, they still lack physicality and power.

In theory, Baleba should solve that issue.

The 22-year-old is strong in possession, covers ground quickly, is good in the air and alert to danger.

Crucially, he also has three years' worth of top-flight experience in England behind him, having moved to Brighton from Lille when he was 19. It gives him the edge on Santos, also 22, and it will be interesting to see whether the pair compete for the same place at the base of Michael Carrick's midfield or if, against the best sides, they might play together.

It will also be fascinating to see if he gets asked to fill in at left-back too.

He has played there before and, unlike Diogo Dalot and Noussair Mazraoui - who could also switch sides if Luke Shaw is unavailable - is left-footed.

Paul Pogba is the only midfield player United have signed for more than the Â£70m they are committing to Baleba which, given his age, is a statement in itself.

'Baleba complements United's other midfielders'

Baleba's appeal lies less in creativity and more in his ability to win possession, cover ground and then carry his team forward.

His 2025-26 campaign was quieter than the previous one, but his 2024-25 numbers show why United have tracked him for so long. He ranked fourth among Premier League midfielders for possessions won in the middle third (107) and interceptions (46), was fifth for ball recoveries (197) and seventh for duels won (199).

That defensive output was matched by his ability to progress possession himself.

Baleba averaged 6.7 progressive carries per 90 minutes, with only three qualifying Premier League defensive midfielders recording more, while 2.9 of those carries travelled at least 10 metres.

His athleticism underpins that game as he reached a top speed of 34.5km/h in 2024-25, compared with 30.5km/h for Casemiro, and averaged 8.2 defensive actions per 90.

He is not necessarily the midfielder United would rely on to dictate possession. Only 11.8% of his passes were classed as line-breaking that season and 22.7% travelled forward - both below the average for central and defensive midfielders.

But that may make him complementary to United's other options rather than a direct alternative. Tielemans can provide more of the progressive distribution, while Baleba offers defensive security and the ability to drive through midfield.

Alongside Kobbie Mainoo, he could take on more of the ball-winning and ground-covering work, while a partnership with Santos could allow Baleba greater freedom to operate box to box.

That versatility is reflected in his positioning as he spent 88% of his minutes last season as a defensive midfielder and 12% in central midfield, suggesting he can anchor the side or step forward depending on who plays alongside him.

United most commonly defended in a 4-2-2-2 last season under Carrick, accounting for 55.9% of their out-of-possession shapes. Baleba's dynamism could be especially valuable in a system where central midfielders are asked to defend large spaces and stop counter-attacks.

There may, however, be an adaptation period.

Baleba is recovering from an ankle ligament injury suffered in pre-season and will need time to recover his match sharpness.

United have also looked to spend longer spells in possession under Carrick, progressing through midfield with quick combinations. Baleba's game is better suited to more open contests, but his passing profile suggests he may need time to adjust to greater responsibility in build-up.

His left foot and mobility should still make him a natural partner for players such as Tielemans or Bruno Fernandes. There is development ahead of him at 22, not least after last season's dip, but at his best Baleba combines defensive activity with the acceleration and carrying power to transform a turnover into an attack within seconds.

articles.title: Bold College Fantasy Football predictions for the 2026 season
articles.summary: Will these six bold college fantasy football predictions come true?
articles.body:
With college football mercifully starting back up this weekend, we will finally get to see how these newly constructed rosters perform in reality as opposed to in theory. Since Yahoo College Fantasy drafts are in full swing, it's time to break out some bold CFF-oriented predictions for the 2026 season.

Jadan Baugh leads the nation in rushing yardage

A powerful-yet-graceful Man Beast, Baugh is 6'1"/228 pounds, squats 565 pounds and has a 4.57 40 speed. He was held back by the hapless Billy Napier last season but managed to score 17+ fantasy points in his last six contests following Napier's dismissal. New Florida head coach Jon Sumrall is well-known for his affinity of using his primary running back as a bell cow, as is evidenced by his prolific usage of Kimani Vidal back at Troy, with Vidal leading the entire nation in rushing under Sumrall's tutelage.

I think Sumrall unleashes Baugh on the SEC, to devastating effect, with the future top-50 NFL Draft pick finally emerging as the star he was destined to be. Baugh is a major priority for me and well worth a first-round fantasy draft selection with the workload he is projected to receive.

Jayden 'Duke' Scott takes the ACC by storm and averages 20 Fantasy PPG

Scott averaged 6.1 yards per touch with a pristine 94% catch rate as Hollywood Smothers' backup last year, and inherits the Wolfpack's starting gig heading into the season. The numbers were recounted in the indispensable Feldman Freaks List , with Scott reportedly running a 4.35s 40-yard dash while squatting 575 lbs with 20 bench reps. Those are rare numbers for a 5'10/235-pounder and well beyond what Smothers is capable of. NC State dodges Miami, Clemson and Notre Dame (honorary ACC member), leaving Scott to feast on the soft underbelly of the ACC. I think Scott clears the elite 20-PPG mark and goes on to have a top-10 College Fantasy campaign.

Ryan Coleman-Williams is a top-five scoring wide receiver

The uncomfortable truth is that Coleman-Williams' 10 drops sabotaged critical opportunities and turned a promising sophomore season into a disappointment. The talent did not vanish; he still averaged 6.8 yards after the catch, showing the same acceleration and open-field creativity that powered his freshman breakout. Now that explosive sophomore QB Keelon Russell has secured the starting job, Coleman-Williams has an Elite-11-winning signal-caller to work with.

Alabama's most difficult defensive test all season comes Oct. 11 versus Georgia, with the remainder of the schedule being very favorable from a fantasy perspective. The news out of camp is that RCW has regained his freshman magic when he reclassified as a 17-year-old in order to play in 2024. I think Coleman-Williams will correct the case of the yips he had in 2025 and ascend back into the upper crust of P4 wide receivers, finishing as a top-five scorer at the position.

Jamal Roberts finishes as a top-15 CFF running back

One of the most important contingency backs in fantasy football after averaging 6.17 yards per carry, Roberts also caught 17 passes for 139 yards and averaged 10.51 per game despite being a backup. Roberts' emergence as a quality RB2 averaging 0.97 fantasy points per touch shows he can support Missouri's offense if asked to lead it, and with breaking news indicating Ahmad Hardy is set to miss at least the first game, we could have a situation where the unfortunate gunshot victim is held back for most of the season until he is completely healthy in order to protect his NFL Draft stock.

Play Yahoo's new College Fantasy Football game: Create or join a league now!

I think Roberts gets the full workload for a Mizzou squad that averaged 228 rushing yards per game last season and returns three starters on a devastating offensive line that boasts 118 total career line starts. Whoever gets that starting job is going to produce, full stop, and I think that player is Roberts.

Omarion Miller takes the WR1 job at ASU and is a top-10 fantasy wideout

I'm a longtime fan of BC-to-ASU transfer WR Reed Harris and his ability to win downfield on the boundary. However, after watching Miller it became clear that he is simply operating at a different level and is deserving of Jordyn Tyson's high volume, alpha-WR1 role in Kenny Dillingham's offense.

Miller came on strong in his final seven games, accruing 608 of his 808 yards and 32 of his 45 receptions, as he took over the Buffs' receiving room while cashing in seven touchdowns over that span. His 34% deep target rate and 3.4 fantasy points per touch average foreshadows a massive leap in production now that he has a proven offensive guru steering the ship. Imagine what Miller is capable of now that he's away from the Colorado circus, where QB JuJu Lewis said they were essentially winging it on offense last year with no real structure.

Miller is a league-winner who is somehow being selected in the Round 8-10 range in most Yahoo Standard Leagues.

Post-hype sleeper QB Nico Iamaleava tears up the Big Ten and averages 25 fantasy points per game

Iamleava was behind the 8-ball last year after transferring late in the cycle from Tennessee to UCLA in a contentious QB swap that sent UCLA signal-caller Joey Aguilar packing to Knoxville. To compound matters, former head coach Deshaun Foster was inarguably one of the worst P4 coaching hires of the last decade, leaving Iamleava without structure and direction. The Bruins brought in new head coach Bob Chesney from James Madison, where he took the Dukes to the CFP Playoff and guided QB Alonza Barnett to an excellent 23.8 fantasy PPG season.

Skillset-wise, Iamleava is essentially a souped-up version of Barnett and was the only returning quarterback in the Power Four who rushed for 400+ yards and failed to eclipse the 20 PPG threshold. As someone who attended several UCLA games over Foster's tenure, and was also present at the Bruins spring game, I can say with confidence that Chesney has completely changed the atmosphere around the program. With Chesney resetting the roster through the transfer portal in the same manner that his JMU predecessor Curt Cignetti did at Indiana, I think UCLA hits the ground running and instantly becomes a credible Big Ten program, with Nico emerging from the post-hype-sleeper doldrums to become a top-20 scoring quarterback and CFF weapon who clears the 25 PPG barrier.

Jamal Roberts finishes as a top-15 CFF running back

One of the most important contingency backs in fantasy football after averaging 6.17 yards per carry, Roberts also caught 17 passes for 139 yards and averaged 10.51 per game despite being a backup. Roberts' emergence as a quality RB2 averaging 0.97 fantasy points per touch shows he can support Missouri's offense if asked to lead it, and with breaking news indicating Ahmad Hardy is set to miss at least the first game, we could have a situation where the unfortunate gunshot victim is held back for most of the season until he is completely healthy in order to protect his NFL Draft stock.
Play Yahoo's new College Fantasy Football game: Create or join a league now!

I think Roberts gets the full workload for a Mizzou squad that averaged 228 rushing yards per game last season and returns three starters on a devastating offensive line that boasts 118 total career line starts. Whoever gets that starting job is going to produce, full stop, and I think that player is Roberts.
Omarion Miller takes the WR1 job at ASU and is a top-10 fantasy wideout

I'm a longtime fan of BC-to-ASU transfer WR Reed Harris and his ability to win downfield on the boundary. However, after watching Miller it became clear that he is simply operating at a different level and is deserving of Jordyn Tyson's high volume, alpha-WR1 role in Kenny Dillingham's offense.

Miller came on strong in his final seven games, accruing 608 of his 808 yards and 32 of his 45 receptions, as he took over the Buffs' receiving room while cashing in seven touchdowns over that span. His 34% deep target rate and 3.4 fantasy points per touch average foreshadows a massive leap in production now that he has a proven offensive guru steering the ship. Imagine what Miller is capable of now that he's away from the Colorado circus, where QB JuJu Lewis said they were essentially winging it on offense last year with no real structure.
Miller is a league-winner who is somehow being selected in the Round 8-10 range in most Yahoo Standard Leagues.
Post-hype sleeper QB Nico Iamaleava tears up the Big Ten and averages 25 fantasy points per game

Iamleava was behind the 8-ball last year after transferring late in the cycle from Tennessee to UCLA in a contentious QB swap that sent UCLA signal-caller Joey Aguilar packing to Knoxville. To compound matters, former head coach Deshaun Foster was inarguably one of the worst P4 coaching hires of the last decade, leaving Iamleava without structure and direction. The Bruins brought in new head coach Bob Chesney from James Madison, where he took the Dukes to the CFP Playoff and guided QB Alonza Barnett to an excellent 23.8 fantasy PPG season.

Skillset-wise, Iamleava is essentially a souped-up version of Barnett and was the only returning quarterback in the Power Four who rushed for 400+ yards and failed to eclipse the 20 PPG threshold. As someone who attended several UCLA games over Foster's tenure, and was also present at the Bruins spring game, I can say with confidence that Chesney has completely changed the atmosphere around the program. With Chesney resetting the roster through the transfer portal in the same manner that his JMU predecessor Curt Cignetti did at Indiana, I think UCLA hits the ground running and instantly becomes a credible Big Ten program, with Nico emerging from the post-hype-sleeper doldrums to become a top-20 scoring quarterback and CFF weapon who clears the 25 PPG barrier.

articles.title: Abdul Abdulmalik: Â£1.5m-rated National League star asks to leave Boreham Wood
articles.summary: Boreham Wood forward Abdul Abdulmalik says he is "capable of reaching the top" after the National League side reject a Â£1.5m offer from Swedish club Djurgarden.
articles.body:
Boreham Wood forward Abdul Abdulmalik said he is "capable of reaching the top" after the National League side rejected a Â£1.5m offer from Swedish club Djurgarden.

The 23-year-old has been the subject of serious interest from the Swedish top-flight side, who had an offer of Â£1m rejected earlier this month.

Boreham Wood do not want to sell Abdulmalik, with manager Luke Garrard saying "he is our player" after the forward was left out of the London club's 3-0 victory over Forest Green on Saturday.

"Everyone at Boreham Wood FC and the incredible fans have played a massive part [in my journey]. You will always have my respect," Adbulmalik said in a statement released by his agent.

"With this said, I'm ready for the next challenge. I'm ready to prove to myself and those around me that I'm capable of reaching the top."

Abdulmalik enjoyed a breakout season in 2025-26, scoring 17 goals and providing 10 assists as Boreham Wood reached the National League play-off final, where he scored and assisted at Wembley.

Djurgarden's Â£1.5m offer would have broken the record fee paid for a fifth-tier player in England, set in 2012 when Leicester paid Fleetwood Town Â£1m for Jamie Vardy.

"Through sheer hard work and perseverance, the opportunity to progress has come around. This is my chance to push myself as a footballer, elevate my game and most importantly fulfil my promise to the ones around me," Abdulmalik continued.

"Opportunities like this are rare, especially within the National League where some of the hardest working talent is overlooked.

"The game of football is forever changing and decisions are fast paced. There's no guarantee that the same chances come knocking twice.

"I owe it to myself and the kids growing up just like me to fight for this one I've been offered."

Abdulmalik came through Millwall's academy, progressing through the club's youth system and representing England at under-17 level.

He was part of the club's Under-21s successes - securing consecutive Professional Development League South titles in 2022-23 and 2023-24.

However, a pathway into consistent first-team football did not materialise and Abdulmalik was released in 2024, before Boreham Wood signed him as a free agent.

BBC Sport has contacted Boreham Wood for comment.

articles.title: Territorio Mateu
articles.standfirst: Espera cerrar dos llegadas y cuatro salidas en los últimos días del mercado. Ya en enero los fichajes llegaron en el último momento, algo habitual en sus anteriores equipos
articles.summary: Espera cerrar dos llegadas y cuatro salidas en los últimos días del mercado. Ya en enero los fichajes llegaron en el último momento, algo habitual en sus anteriores equipos
articles.body: Dos operaciones de entrada y cuatro de salida. Esa es la hoja de ruta marcada por Mateu Alemany en estos últimos días de mercado. Fichar un 9 (Nico Jackson es la prioridad) y recuperar a Nico Gonzalez, en el primer apartado. Colocar a Giménez, Lemar, Carlos Martín y Obed Vargas en un espacio de tiempo que es territorio Mateu. Porque cuando las ventanas de fichaje agonizan llega el momento del balear. No hay que viajar en el tiempo para descubrirlo. En su primer mercado como rojiblanco, el invernal, Mateu consiguió cerrar sus tres incorporaciones en las últimas 72 horas. Primero, con el fichaje estelar de Lookman, al que se le colocaba en Turquía hasta la aparición rojiblanca desvelada por MARCA. Luego, con la llegada sorprendente de Obed Vargas... que rejuveneció la medular junto al fichaje en el cierre del mercado de Rodrigo Mendoza, una de las grandes joyas del fútbol español. La habilidad del balear para cerrar operaciones al final del mercado viene de lejos. En el verano de 2021 consiguió la cesión de Luuk de Jong mientras lograba cerrar la salida de Antoine Griezmann, también a préstamo, rumbo al Atlético de Madrid. Junto al francés se marchó Emerson Royal al Tottenham. No sólo apuró como azulgrana en los mercados veraniegos, más dados a operaciones por la disposición económica más solvente. En el invierno de 2022 llevó al Camp Nou a Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang:, que se cerró en los últimos minutos del 31 de enero, tras lograr que el jugador rescindiera su contrato con el Arsenal para llegar libre. Adama Traoré también llegó a préstamo cuando el mercado agonizaba.  Antes de arribar en el Barça, Mateu lideró el último gran Valencia. En Mestalla dejó un grato recuerdo y operaciones de última hora como las de un Gonzalo Guedes que es, sin duda, su momento álgido en cuanto a fichajes postreros. El futbolista, que ya había estado en Mestalla un año antes, acabó como valencianista a escasos tres días de mercado tras sacar Alemany al jugador del PSG por una importante cantidad de 40 millones de euros. Un año antes ya había firmado operaciones de calado con Andreas Pereira y Kondogbia, dos más de los nombres que logró abrochar en el llamado Territorio Mateu.

articles.title: Gianni Infantino: Irish FA withdraws support for Fifa president
articles.summary: The Irish Football Association says it is "time for change" at Fifa and they will not be voting for president Gianni Infantino's re-election next year.
articles.body:
The Irish Football Association says it is "time for change" at Fifa and they will not be voting for president Gianni Infantino's re-election next year.

Infantino has been under increasing scrutiny since his aborted attempt to sell off a 21% stake in Fifa's commercial operations to a private investment company.

The plans were scrapped after widespread criticism, with Uefa threatening a boycott of all Fifa competitions.

The IFA, the governing body for football in Northern Ireland, had previously backed Uefa's stance without formally withdrawing their support, but have now said Infantino's plan raised "fundamental questions" of the president.

It said in a statement: "The proposal to sell part of Fifa's assets to a private equity firm without consultation, represents more than a failure of communication. In our view, it raises fundamental questions about strategy, governance and stewardship of our assets.

"We believe the time has come for change."

The Football Associations of England, Scotland, Wales and the Republic of Ireland have previously publicly withdrawn support for Infantino , who is scheduled to stand for a fourth term as president in March.

Should the 56-year-old Swiss be successful, by the end of the term in 2031, his tenure will have been extended to 15 years.

articles.title: ACC Considering Rule Change Barring NFL Players from Returning to CFB Amid Big Ten Rumors
articles.summary: Following in the Big Ten's footsteps, the ACC is reportedly considering a rule change that could prohibit schools from adding players who were previously in the NFL.
articles.body:
Following in the Big Ten's footsteps, the ACC is reportedly considering a rule change that could prohibit schools from adding players who were previously in the NFL.

On Tuesday, the Big Ten reportedly passed a rule preventing NFL players from returning to college, per ESPN's Pete Thamel.

Now the ACC is looking to pass a similar rule, per Ralph D. Russo, Chris Vannini, Scott Dochterman and Seth Emerson of The Athletic .

"The ACC is considering a similar conference-wide rule, Wake Forest athletic director and ACC athletic director chair John Currie told The Athletic. The league's athletic directors have a regularly scheduled meeting Wednesday, and this discussion will be part of the agenda."

The Big 12 is reporting considering a similar ban, per Ross Dellenger of Yahoo Sports.

On Monday, ESPN's Adam Schefter reported that undrafted free agent tight end Dae'Quan Wright, who was waived by the Cleveland Browns, has an agreement to play for LSU.

A Louisiana judge's temporary restraining order has carved the path for Wright to return to college, where he played for Virginia Tech in 2022 and 2023 and Ole Miss in 2024 and 2025.

Wright is among 33 athletes who can could gain an extra collegiate season. He is one of three athletes who signed with a pro team but can choose that path alongside running back Anthony Hankerson (Miami Dolphins and Seattle Seahawks) and linebacker Jack Pyburn (Tampa Bay Buccaneers). Hankerson has been waived, while Pyburn is still on the Bucs' roster.

Some big-name coaches had mixed opinions on NFL players returning to college. Oregon head coach Dan Lanning was clearly opposed to it, while Ohio State head coach Ryan Day was at least open to the matter.

The Big Ten has ultimately shut the door on the possibility. The ACC may follow suit.

The SEC doesn't like the practice either and released a statement on the matter, but there wasn't word on whether the conference would pass a rule banning it.

It seems like a common-sense move to ban pro players from returning to school. The situation still has to play itself out, though, as news continuously develops on the matter.

articles.standfirst: Este mismo martes se puede anunciar el fichaje del jugador de PSV
articles.summary: Este mismo martes se puede anunciar el fichaje del jugador de PSV
articles.body: Couhaib Driouech llegó esta tarde a Vigo. El futbolista se desplazó a la Sede Social del club para firmar su contrato y este mismo martes puede ser anunciado como la quinta incorporación céltica. Por el futbolista de 24 años procedente del PSV, donde ha firmado dos muy buenas temporadas, el Celta abonará una cantidad cercana a los 7 millones. Es la primera operación por la que el club vigués paga traspaso este verano. Con este refuerzo para el ataque, solicitado por Claudio Giráldez, faltarían para completar la plantilla un central derecho, de rendimiento inmediato, y un mediocampista, según peticiones del entrenador. La prioridad es la llegada del defensa.

articles.title: 5-Star OT Austin Attalah Announces CFB Commitment Between Texas, Texas Tech, USC
articles.summary: The college football season kicks off this week, but Texas Tech has already scored a win thanks to top offensive tackle recruit Austin Attalah.
articles.body:
The college football season kicks off this week, but Texas Tech has already scored a win thanks to top offensive tackle recruit Austin Attalah.

Attalah told Hayes Fawcett of Rivals.com on Tuesday that he will join the Red Raiders as part of their 2028 recruiting class. The California native picked Texas Tech over Texas and USC.

247Sports' composite rankings have Attalah rated as a 5-star prospect, the third-best offensive tackle and No. 27 overall recruit in 2028.

In his scouting evaluation of Attalah for 247Sports, Gabe Brooks described his hand work and punch power as "works in progress" but the ceiling is that of a "high-major tackle who could become a pro prospect."

Attalah's commitment is yet another recruiting win for head coach Joey McGuire. Texas Tech has been among the best programs in the nation at landing new talent over the past two years.

The 2025 season saw the Red Raiders finish with the No. 2 transfer portal class in the country thanks to additions like David Bailey and Romello Height.

That group helped catapult Texas Tech to a 12-2 record, its first double-digit win season since 2008 and its first-ever Big 12 title. The team made the College Football Playoff as the No. 4 seed, but lost its first playoff game to Oregon in the quarterfinal.

McGuire and his staff have been able to carry that momentum over into 2026 and beyond. The incoming freshman class this year is ranked 15th nationally, led by 5-star tackle Felix Ojo.

It's still very early in the 2028 recruiting cycle, but Attalah is one of two players the Red Raiders have landed thus far. The other is punter Luc Normand.

Texas Tech will open this season ranked No. 12 in the Associated Press Top 25 poll, its highest spot in the preseason poll since 2008. The Red Raiders will open the year against Abilene Christian on Sept. 5.

It's still very early in the 2028 recruiting cycle, but Attalah is one of two players the Red Raiders have landed thus far. The other is punter Luc Normand.

Texas Tech will open this season ranked No. 12 in the Associated Press Top 25 poll, its highest spot in the preseason poll since 2008. The Red Raiders will open the year against Abilene Christian on Sept. 5.

articles.title: Bradley Barcola transfer news: Liverpool hold fresh talks with PSG over France international ahead of transfer deadline
articles.summary: Liverpool hold positive talks with PSG over Bradley Barcola; there is optimism that a deal can be struck for the winger; there has been a gap in valuation between two clubs throughout summer, with PSG asking for around £145m for Barcola; Reds also interested in PSG's Ibrahim Mbaye
articles.body:
Liverpool are holding further talks with Paris Saint-Germain on Tuesday for Bradley Barcola.

There has been a gap in valuation between the two clubs throughout the summer, with PSG asking for around £145m for the France international.

However, the discussions that have taken place during this window have been described as positive, and there is optimism that a deal can be struck with a week left before the deadline.

Sky Sports News understands there are good relations between the two clubs at the highest level. It is hoped this will help Liverpool and PSG reach an agreement.

Liverpool have also explored a move for Barcola's team-mate, Ibrahim Mbaye, who plays off the right wing.

The Premier League club's priority throughout this window has been to reinforce in wide areas.

They have been pursuing Barcola and Mbaye, while Brighton have also rejected two Liverpool offers for Yankuba Minteh, the latest being £60m.

Liverpool are currently the only club chasing Barcola, who has entered the final two years of his deal and has grown dissatisfied with his role at the European champions.

Liverpool, meanwhile, do not want to sell Cody Gakpo amid interest from Tottenham and Manchester City and would likely need two new wingers in before considering letting the Netherlands international go.

articles.title: Driouech firma con el Celta hasta 2030
articles.standfirst: El club vigués hace oficial el fichaje del extremo procedente de PSV
articles.summary: El club vigués hace oficial el fichaje del extremo procedente de PSV
articles.body: El Celta hizo oficial este martes su quinta incorporación cara a la presente temporada. Couhaib Driouech firma por el club vigués por cuatro temporadas, hasta junio de 2030. Por el traspaso del extremo, el Celta pagará al PSV una cantidad cercana a los 7 millones. Es el primer desembolso que el club vigués realiza este verano, ya que Aleix Febas y Javi Galán llegaron con la carta de libertad y Faye y Bayindir lo hicieron cedidos. Driouech, de 24 años, nació en los Países Bajos y tiene ascendencia marroquí. En los dos últimos años en PSV ha disputado 61 encuentros oficiales en los que ha marcado 12 goles y dado 10 asistencias. En todo ese periodo disputó Champions, competición en la que jugó 12 partidos, hizo 4 goles y dio 2 asistencias. El Celta recibe al futbolista, señalando: “Driouech es un extremo diestro que se desenvuelve principalmente en la banda izquierda, aunque también puede actuar por el costado derecho. Su perfil aporta velocidad, desborde y capacidad para generar ventajas en el último tercio, destacando especialmente en el uno contra uno, en los cambios de ritmo y en su capacidad para atacar los espacios a la espalda de la defensa. Sus características encajan a la perfección en el esquema de Claudio Giráldez, por lo que su incorporación aportará profundidad, desequilibrio y nuevas alternativas al ataque celeste” Y añade: “Con la llegada de Driouech, el Celta incorpora a un futbolista joven, con experiencia al más alto nivel y un perfil con margen para seguir creciendo de cara a una temporada que volverá a ser ilusionante”. El jugador ya se pone a las órdenes de Claudio Giráldez, que con su llegada cierra la zona de ataque de su plantilla.

articles.title: La unidad 'B' del Córdoba gana moral ante el San José
articles.standfirst: Theo Zidane e Ibai Sanz, sin minutos aún en Liga, dan la victoria a los blanquiverdes en un amistoso por el aniversario del club sevillano (1-2)
articles.summary: Theo Zidane e Ibai Sanz, sin minutos aún en liga, dan la victoria a los blanquiverdes en un amistoso por el aniversario del club sevillano (1-2)
articles.body: Aprovechando la larga semana entre partidos de Liga, del viernes 21 ante el Girona al domingo 30 contra el Granada, el Córdoba disputó este martes un partido amistoso ante el modesto San José, de la Primera Andaluza de Sevilla, con motivo del 75º aniversario del equipo rinconero. El conjunto cordobesista se impuso en la segunda parte (1-2) tras verse inicialmente por debajo en el marcador. Iván Ania pudo dar minutos a jugadores que aún no se estrenaron en la Liga, como Guilherme Fernandes, Theo Zidane, Ibai Sanz o el último fichaje del verano, Budesca. También otros que entraron en las segundas partes como Damián Cáceres o Kevin Medina, que tuvo una de las mejores ocasiones del primer acto con un intento de gol olímpico que evitó Ismael. Viti, uno de los canteranos que pudieron jugar (como Miguelón, Albuera o el hijo de Diego Tristán, del mismo nombre), también tuvo su ocasión para marcar El San José no sólo aguantó al 0-0 al descanso, sino que se adelantó nada más empezar la reanudación con diana de Dima. Cerca del cuarto de hora de la reanudación, una buena resolución de Theo Zidane supuso el 1-1. Álex Arévalo, Ángel, Javi Antrás, Borja García y Pablo Muñoz dejaron el once califal de la segunda mitad casi lleno de canteranos, aunque Ibai Sanz, que continuó jugando, firmó el tanto de la remontada y de la victoria. Viti, ya en el 90', estuvo cerca del tercero.

articles.title: Al Nassr remonta un 2-0 sin Cristiano, con 10 y gracias a Mané y Joao Félix
articles.standfirst: CR7 sólo jugó la primera parte, cuando su equipo caía 2-0
articles.summary: CR7 sólo jugó la primera parte, cuando su equipo caía 2-0
articles.body: Al Nasrr, vigente campeón de Liga, remontó un 2-0 en una segunda parte en la que mostró carácter, pues jugaba con 10 jugadores (desde el minuto 13), iba perdiendo dos abajo y no tenía a Cristiano en cancha, ya que el 7 fue sustituido en el descanso. El crack portugués se tendrá que quedar con los actuales 978 goles en su búsqueda de los 1.000 en su carrera. El campeón de Liga  parecía haber forjado su tumba en ese minuto 13', con una roja clara al portero Bento que dejaba al Nassr con 10 jugadores. Y ya todo parecía acabado para los de Cristiano Ronaldo con la entrada en cancha del joven portero Al Otaibi. El cancerbero falló en el primer tanto de Duda y en el segundo del español Álvaro Medrán, en un disparo lejano que se le escapó entre las manos. 2-0 al descanso y Cristiano apenas tuvo un disparo con opciones de gol en esta mitad. Se fue a vestuarios enojado por el resultado. En el descanso, CR7 fue sustituido, algo raro, pues suele jugar casi todo, y menos con 2-0 en contra. Pero no salió al campo en un partido con mucha mala suerte para el Nassr (poste de Íñigo Martínez y gol anulado en el 53' a los visitantes).   Pero, a partir de ahí, vino la reacción del Nassr, que empató gracias a dos asistencias del portugués Joao Félix (MVP de la pasada temporada) en apenas tres minutos. Los goles fueron de Mané y Al Amri de cabeza. Todo en tres minutos y sin Cristiano.  Y el 2-3 final vino ya en el 90', en un contragolpe de los visitantes, que certificaban, con el segundo de Mané, una victoria con sólo 10 jugadores. Heroica.

articles.title: El Betis activa otra bronca en Mestalla
articles.standfirst: Pablo García, en el 83’ marcó el tanto definitivo del partido tras un gran contragolpe verdiblanco
articles.summary: Pablo García, en el 83’ marcó el tanto definitivo del partido tras un gran contragolpe verdiblanco
articles.body: El Betis activó otra bronca en Mestalla con una victoria forjada en los minutos finales, cuando el partido se había convertido en un correcalles que el equipo verdiblanco supo manejar por fútbol y por piernas. Fue un buen pase de Fran García el que habilitó el golazo de Pablo García, de volea con la izquierda en la frontal del área. Después, Sadiq tuvo dos ocasiones, una clarísima, que no acertó a embocar, lo que disparó el enfado desde la grada en apenas tres días y dos jornadas disputadas. Después del 0-0 ante el Celta, se había propuesto Corberán que el Valencia ganara frescura ofensiva sin perder la solidez que le aportan los cinco defensas. Por eso mandó a Sato hacia la derecha y a Danjuma, a la izquierda, con Hugo Duro en punta. El delantero japonés generaba, provocaba, pero no terminaba de conectar. Cruzó demasiado su primer disparo y se encontró con una buena parada de Álvaro Valles, en el segundo. No era un desasosiego constante en el área verdiblanca, pero el Betis tampoco terminaba de responder con algún golpe intimidatorio, aunque tuviera mucho más tiempo el balón. Algún chispazo de Antony, un cambio de orientación de Fornals y poco más, para desesperación del Cucho Hernández, que no paraba de pedir alguna pelota. Casi todo pasaba por la banda derecha del Valencia, con Maffeo muy estirado en funciones ofensivas hasta provocar una amarilla de Firpo. Motivo de más para seguir insistiendo en la segunda parte por ese costado, hasta que Pellegrini quitó al lateral dominicano para evitar males mayores. Para entonces Diakhaby ya había arrebatado un balón de la cabeza al Cucho y Corberán trataba de revitalizar a su equipo con tres cambios. Respondió Pellegrini metiendo a uno de los pocos jugadores capaces de filtrar pases entre líneas hiperpobladas de contrarios. En su primera intervención robó a Guido y trató de sorprender a Dimitrievski, algo adelantado pero atento. Pero no era control y pase lo que pedía el partido en los minutos finales, sino piernas para correr. Las tuvo Parrott, que se pudo coronar en el primer balón que tocaba, pero cruzó demasiado el balón, quizá confiado en que iban anular la acción por fuera de juego. Le faltó decisión después a Sadiq para rematar. A ese error le siguió otro de Fornals, al que un mal control le arruinó una gran jugada de Antony. Pero no falló Pablo García en otro contragolpe que lanzó el mismo y que remató de volea a la red tras un gran centro de Fran García. Acto seguido, Álvaro Valles evitó un gol cantado de Sadiq dentro del área. Esa acción activó el conocido estado de ebullición en Mestalla, con cánticos contra Corberán y la directiva.

articles.title: Diego Llorente: "Este es el Betis que necesitamos este año, todos tenemos que estar preparados"
articles.standfirst: El central madrileño destaca la aportación de todo el equipo en el triunfo bético en Mestalla
articles.summary: El central madrileño destaca la aportación de todo el equipo en el triunfo bético en Mestalla
articles.body: Diego Llorente ejerció este martes como capitán del Betis en la victoria de los verdiblancos en Mestalla por 0-1 frente al Valencia. Un golazo de Pablo García en el tramo final del partido permite a los de Pellegrini firmar el pleno de triunfos en el arranque liguero, después de haberse impuesto el pasado viernes en La Cartuja a la Real Sociedad. El central madrileño, en DAZN, destacó la necesidad de rotaciones en su equipo en una temporada muy cargada de partidos. Un triunfo trabajado: "Sí, muy trabajado. Sabíamos que ellos no habían tenido un buen inicio, que era un campo complicado, pero que no podíamos especular. Yo creo que, desde el primero hasta el último que ha entrado, los cambios también han ayudado mucho al equipo, y toda la plantilla está muy bien." Mejoría en la segunda parte: "Al final hay mini partidos dentro de un propio partido y había que saber cuándo acelerar, cuándo frenar un poco. articles.title: Pellegrini: "Faltan un par de retoques, pero el plantel va por el camino correcto"
articles.standfirst: El técnico del Betis valora muy positivamente el triunfo de su equipo en Mestalla por 0-1
articles.summary: El técnico del Betis valora muy positivamente el triunfo de su equipo en Mestalla por 0-1
articles.body: Manuel Pellegrini, se mostró muy satisfecho con el rendimiento de su equipo, rotaciones incluidas, en su victoria por 0-1 en Mestalla frente al Valencia. Un golazo de Pablo García en los minutos finales del partido le dio a los verdiblancos su segundo triunfo de la temporada para firmar un pleno de seis puntos de seis posibles que sitúan a los andaluces en la zona alta de la clasificación... empatados con su eterno rival, el Sevilla. Valoración del triunfo: "La verdad que tres puntos muy importantes ante un rival difícil, además jugando de visita. Creo que fue un partido muy disputado por los dos equipos, muy cerrado con pocas ocasiones, pero creo que al final fuimos justo ganadores". Lo que más destaca de su equipo: "Bueno, primero la concentración defensiva. Quizás muchos tuvieran sorpresa que se cambiara toda la línea de cuatro, pero venimos de una pretemporada recién terminada. Tenemos que jugar ocho partidos en 27 días, en 26 días, así que no sentía que era un riesgo porque le había visto de rendimiento, que al final es lo que indica cuáles son los titulares, a los ocho defensores durante toda la pretemporada. Así que muy contento por haber podido ocupar el plantel y estamos todos compenetrados en sacar los resultados. Después creo que el funcionamiento del equipo, manteniendo otra vez la portería en blanco de todo el equipo, comprometido en la recuperación y muy ordenado, creo que nos hizo muy bien. Y al final quizás, sobre todo el primer tiempo, estuvimos con poca creación, con poca movilidad para poder hacerle más daño a Valencia. Ellos también tuvieron solamente una llegada, así que como digo, fue un partido parejo donde un golazo lo desequilibró". Pablo García y el mercado: "No, yo creo que ya eso es un tema que está para mí cerrado. Mientras estén incorporados en el plantel, van a ser jugadores que yo los voy a usar. Pablo García, Nelson Deossa, el que esté. Por otro lado, lo de Pablo son solamente especulaciones. Yo siempre digo que cada jugador que sale debilita, por supuesto, el plantel. Nos falta todavía una semana para intentar cerrar una plantilla que nos permita estar tanto en Champions como en la Liga, intentando buscar nuevamente una clasificación europea y vamos a ver cómo se da estos días. Ojalá que hubiera la menor cantidad de salidas posible". La profundidad del banquillo: "Sí, así es. Por eso tenemos un plantel ya bastante estable, un plantel bastante parecido a lo que teníamos antes. También lo dije que falta un par de retoques. Bueno, falta la Champions League y jugar muchos partidos a mitad de semana, pero creo que el plantel va por el camino correcto porque independiente de los nombres, el funcionamiento y el compromiso de cada uno de ellos es innegable durante los 90 minutos".
